quests.title: 01 | The Letter in the Ashes
quests.section: I. A Fire in the Ashes
quests.story:
Eldara hands you a letter sealed with a broken sun. "If anyone still walks the Ash Road, bring a light. We are not all dead." It is signed Rowan, keeper of a village that no map remembers. Eldara coordinates the main chronicle. Rowan and the other companions offer their own requests when you speak to them.

Accept this quest from Eldara, keep a crafting table in your inventory, then turn it in to her. Press minus (-) to track progress. Return to Eldara for each new main assignment. Explore at your own pace; side stories never block the main ending.

quests.title: 02 | A Light on the Road
quests.section: I. A Fire in the Ashes
quests.story:
Rowan writes that refugees follow torchlight, even when they no longer trust voices. You cannot bring back the old road, but you can mark a safe stretch of the new one.

Gather 16 torches and 16 cobblestone. Choose a campsite near food and timber. Placing lights is encouraged; the journal checks supplies held.

quests.title: 03 | The Empty Granary
quests.section: I. A Fire in the Ashes
quests.story:
The relief ledger has a column for swords and another for mouths. The second is longer. Rowan asks for bread before banners.

Donate 8 bread to the relief stores. Keep a separate ration for yourself.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the empty granary with Tamsin. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the empty granary with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: The supplies will reach the kitchen. Ask who could not come to collect them; hunger often stays behind the door that opens least.

quests.title: 04 | The Smith Without a Forge
quests.section: I. A Fire in the Ashes
quests.story:
Mara, once the royal smith, survived by mending cooking pots. She offers the same lesson to every would-be hero: a shield is worth more than a grand epitaph.

Acquire a shield and 8 iron ingots. Bring the shield into your main inventory for the collection check before equipping it.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the missing forge with Mara. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the missing forge with Mara
objectives.dialogue: These supplies will build a working forge. The first tools go to repairs and planting. People need reasons to stay as well as weapons to defend them.

quests.title: 05 | What Walks After Sunset
quests.section: I. A Fire in the Ashes
quests.story:
There is no army coming to relieve the night watch. The dead have begun wearing strips of the old king's colors. Mara burns the scraps without speaking.

Defeat 6 zombies and 4 skeletons. Kill objectives use your lifetime Minecraft kill statistics; previous victories may already count.

quests.title: 06 | The First Hearth
quests.section: I. A Fire in the Ashes
quests.story:
You name the refuge Dawnstead. It may be a cottage, a fortified camp, or the first street of a future city. Rowan records its founding with a single line: "We stayed."

Acquire a campfire, a chest, and 16 oak planks. Set up your own refuge afterward. The quest checks these supplies, not a building layout. Your first guild commissions are now within reach.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the first common hearth with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the first common hearth with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Every household has room in the ledger, including those on the road. A common hearth lets newcomers approach without an introduction.

quests.title: The Names beyond the Gate
quests.section: I.b | The Long Road to Dawnstead
quests.story:
Rowan opens a second ledger. The first records people who reached Dawnstead; the second records settlements that have stopped answering. You cannot call this a refuge while its neighbors vanish.

Acquire a writable book and a compass for the missing settlements survey. The named settlements are journal fiction; choose real villages in your world as their counterparts.

quests.title: The Mill without Grain
quests.section: I.b | The Long Road to Dawnstead
quests.story:
A miller has been grinding bark into flour. Rowan asks for a harvest, not another promise that soldiers will eventually make the road safe.

Donate 32 wheat and 16 carrots to the first relief caravan. Start crops if you lack a renewable supply.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: An Empty Saddle
quests.section: I.b | The Long Road to Dawnstead
quests.story:
Iona finds a courier's abandoned equipment. The next dispatch will travel with someone who knows how to care for a companion instead of treating it as expendable.

Tame an animal and earn Best Friends Forever. A horse is a useful travel choice, but any animal satisfying the advancement counts.

quests.title: The Lantern Ferry
quests.section: I.b | The Long Road to Dawnstead
quests.story:
With provisions loaded and a scout ready, the caravan reaches a broken crossing. Fen offers boats if Dawnstead will help repair his landing.

Donate 24 oak planks and 8 iron ingots for the ferry. Design a crossing in your own world if you wish; the turn-in checks supplies only.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: A Road beneath Their Feet
quests.section: I.b | The Long Road to Dawnstead
quests.story:
The dead wait beneath the bridge supports. Elian thinks they are drawn to the travelers above; Sera suspects the old burial ground predates the river.

Reach 8 drowned kills and 12 zombie kills in your lifetime Minecraft kill statistics. Previous kills count; do not treat these as a fresh wave defense.

quests.title: The Bell Nobody Rings
quests.section: I.b | The Long Road to Dawnstead
quests.story:
At the next village the bell is wrapped in cloth. The residents fear that sound will attract the raiders. Rowan asks you to give them a reason to uncover it.

Complete the vanilla What a Deal! advancement by trading with a villager. Establish a trading contact and leave the village better protected than you found it.

quests.title: A Workshop on Wheels
quests.section: I.b | The Long Road to Dawnstead
quests.story:
Mara packs repair tools in a cart. "A road is not open because you walked it once," she says. "Someone must keep walking it."

Acquire an anvil and 16 rails for a mobile workshop supply cache. You keep both; build the workshop wherever it serves your journey.

quests.title: The First Free Road
quests.section: I.b | The Long Road to Dawnstead
quests.story:
The first answer arrives: three villages have agreed to exchange supplies through Dawnstead. Elian unfolds a captured raider banner beside the letters. Someone will object to this new freedom.

Donate 8 leather and 16 paper for the road compact. This completes the regional prologue and returns you to The Broken Banner.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: 07 | A Banner with No King
quests.story:
A courier reaches Dawnstead with a warning: raiders are demanding taxes in the dead king's name. Their tribute caravans travel toward a ruined archive. Someone is paying for a war.

Acquire a compass and 24 paper to begin charting the raider routes. Maps and generated structures are yours to explore; no fixed coordinates are assumed.

quests.title: 08 | Break the Roadblock
quests.story:
Captain Elian's surviving scouts refuse to abandon the road. They do not need a glorious charge. They need the crossbows to stop firing.

Defeat 8 pillagers. Patrols, outposts, and suitable modded raider structures can provide targets; ordinary pillagers are the tracked enemy.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the cleared roadblock with Elian. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the cleared roadblock with Elian
objectives.dialogue: I will assign a returning patrol before declaring the road open. Travelers deserve more than yesterday's victory.

quests.title: 09 | Armor for the Watch
quests.story:
Mara cannot arm everyone with legends. She can arm them with iron. While the scouts hunt the raiders, her forge works through the night.

Donate 16 iron ingots and 12 leather to equip the watch. This supply mission and the roadblock hunt can be completed in either order.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: 10 | The Collector
quests.story:
The raider collector carries orders to seize books as well as grain. Elian realizes these soldiers are searching for something the kingdom buried deliberately.

With the roadblock broken and the watch supplied, defeat 2 vindicators. Search woodland mansions or other suitable illager strongholds.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the collector's records with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the collector's records with Sera
objectives.dialogue: These entries explain what was taken, not what was owed. Keep that distinction in the account you take to Eldara.

quests.title: 11 | The Siege Beast
quests.story:
A ravager tears through the old toll gate. Its harness bears the same broken sun as Rowan's letter. The king's own quartermasters once armed these beasts.

Defeat one ravager. Prepare a controlled battlefield and protect villagers if you choose to obtain the fight through a raid.

quests.title: 12 | A Debt Written in Ink
quests.story:
Among the captured accounts, archivist Sera finds payments to the royal crypt. "The king did not lose his crown," she writes. "He mortgaged it. We must learn what he bought."

Bring 4 books and 8 ink sacs for Sera's reconstruction of the ledger. The archive opens the next chapter and several scholarly side stories.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the debt in ink with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the debt in ink with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Several families signed under threat. The circumstances belong beside the promises; signatures are not the whole story.

quests.title: The Water Tastes of Iron
quests.section: II.b | The Fever in the Reeds
quests.story:
A caravan brings patients instead of goods. Tamsin discovers that each drank from streams near the ruined royal fishery. The captured ledger calls that place a research station.

Acquire 12 glass bottles and 4 buckets for the investigation. You are preparing a field camp, not performing an automatic water-quality scan.

quests.title: The Kitchen Hospital
quests.section: II.b | The Fever in the Reeds
quests.story:
Tamsin turns the tavern kitchen into a dispensary. The cooks complain until she reminds them that every patient once bought their supper here.

Donate 12 honey bottles and 16 cooked chicken. Establish bees or gather honey carefully; the relief shipment gives early farming a lasting purpose.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: What Sleeps in the Bait
quests.section: II.b | The Fever in the Reeds
quests.story:
Fen remembers fishermen using rotten bait to lure something they refused to name. He draws the recipe with a shaking hand.

Acquire Meet Your Fight's Fossil Bait. Its installed recipe uses bones, rotten flesh, and spider eyes; verify the full pattern in JEI.

quests.title: The Doctor's Arsenal
quests.section: II.b | The Fever in the Reeds
quests.story:
The bait is ready, and the patients can be fed. Tamsin now insists on the unheroic necessities: a way to wash wounds and a warm place to wait.

Acquire a cauldron, a campfire, and 16 clean glass blocks for a field dispensary. Keep the supplies and build where you prefer.

quests.title: The Blackwater Teeth
quests.section: II.b | The Fever in the Reeds
quests.story:
Swampjaw rises where the fishery once dumped its refuse. Sera refuses to call the creature evil. That does not make its hunger survivable.

Use Fossil Bait according to Meet Your Fight's mechanics and defeat Swampjaw. Prepare an open combat area away from villagers and your base.

quests.title: No One Left in the Reeds
quests.section: II.b | The Fever in the Reeds
quests.story:
With the creature gone, Fen can reach the stranded boats. The passengers have endured enough dark nights to stop believing in rescue.

Donate 16 cooked cod and 16 white wool for food and bedding. White wool is the exact requested item; other colors do not satisfy this shipment.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Fishery's Last Invoice
quests.section: II.b | The Fever in the Reeds
quests.story:
Inside the accounts Sera finds a charge for arcane reagents signed by a royal necromancer. The disease was a consequence of an experiment the court considered successful.

Gather 8 amethyst shards and 8 redstone for Sera's examination. The analysis is told in the journal; these items remain yours.

quests.title: A Name for the Illness
quests.section: II.b | The Fever in the Reeds
quests.story:
Tamsin records the recovered patients. Sera names the cause: the covenant is not just a contract but an extraction process. The archive beneath the archive may tell you how it works.

Enter "the living are not fuel" in the text field to publish the findings. The next story chapter opens the magical investigation.

objectives.label: Write: the living are not fuel

quests.title: 13 | The Archive Beneath the Archive
quests.story:
Sera deciphers the margins. The royal seal is not a crest but a diagram: fire below, death within, a star beyond. The king bound the realm to three wardens and called the bargain peace.

Acquire an enchanting table. Enchanting is useful for every combat style; the story does not require you to become a mage.

quests.title: 14 | The First Ward
quests.story:
Mara refuses to send you against a king's curse in untested equipment. "Whatever weapon you favor," she says, "give it a reason to survive."

Complete the vanilla Enchanter advancement by enchanting an item. Use the Arcane College side story if you also want to develop spellcasting.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the first ward with Mara. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the first ward with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The fitting holds in a simple test. Tell Eldara what we tested and what remains uncertain. A prototype is a beginning.

quests.title: 15 | Dust That Remembers
quests.story:
The ink in the ledger moves near arcane essence. Sera believes the scribes recorded their memories in magic before the archive burned.

Collect 12 Arcane Essence from Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks. Explore, loot, or use available recipes shown in JEI. Keep it for your own spellcraft afterward.

quests.title: 16 | The Man Who Counted Graves
quests.story:
The restored memory names a necromancer who supplied bodies to the court. Sera asks you to end his work before he supplies Dawnstead with its own dead.

Defeat one Iron's Spellbooks necromancer. Search that mod's hostile wizard encounters and structures; the exact tracked entity is irons_spellbooks:necromancer.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the counted graves with Tamsin. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the counted graves with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Numbers help organize care. Families also need names and somewhere to ask questions. Bring both kinds of record.

quests.title: 17 | The Threefold Seal
quests.story:
The necromancer's notes reveal a weakness. Dragonfire can expose the covenant, a furnace beneath the Nether can break its iron, and the outer darkness holds its final witness. Sera will not let you mistake knowledge for invulnerability.

Acquire a diamond chestplate and 8 obsidian. You may fight in any armor you prefer; these are milestones, not a required loadout.

quests.title: 18 | No More Borrowed Peace
quests.story:
Elian asks whether exposing the bargain will bring another war. Rowan answers: "A peace that eats our children is already a war." You commit to breaking the covenant rather than inheriting it.

Read the oath and enter "no borrowed peace" in the quest's text field. This is a story acknowledgement, not a hidden password puzzle.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the end of borrowed peace with Elian. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the end of borrowed peace with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The watch is ready. We must also decide how residents can question orders given in their name.

quests.title: A Captain's Missing Company
quests.story:
Elian recognizes a name in the necromancer's records: the regiment he was ordered to abandon. He asks you to investigate before he calls himself fit to lead another expedition.

Acquire a spyglass and 16 torches for the search. Plan a route through caves and ruins where the old war left its defenders.

quests.title: Weapons for Survivors
quests.story:
Mara cannot bring back the soldiers. She can make sure the people searching for them are properly equipped.

Acquire a Simply Swords iron greatsword alternative: specifically the iron claymore, plus a shield. You may use any combat loadout after the collection check.

quests.title: The Roll of the Missing
quests.story:
Sera refuses to copy "presumed dead" across an entire page. She asks for enough materials to record each life separately.

Donate 8 books and 16 ink sacs to the memorial archive. This investigation can proceed alongside the armory work.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Men inside the Armor
quests.story:
Bones still move through the abandoned tunnel. Elian reads their insignia aloud until he recognizes none of them. That frightens him more than recognition.

Reach 24 skeleton kills total. Carry healing and light; the tracked total includes your earlier encounters.

quests.title: The Smith's Apology
quests.story:
Mara admits that she forged weapons for the same campaign. Neither she nor Elian knew what the king planned to do with the dead. Neither accepts ignorance as absolution.

Acquire 12 gold ingots and 16 lapis lazuli for reinforced equipment and enchantment work. Prepare before the next boss expedition.

quests.title: The Guard at the Wrong Door
quests.story:
The Ferrous Wroughtnaut stands before a chamber emptied long ago. Elian sees a soldier who was never told that the orders had ended.

Find and defeat Mowzie's Mobs' Ferrous Wroughtnaut. Learn its openings rather than expecting every attack to deal damage.

quests.title: Orders Rescinded
quests.story:
Elian writes his first honest dispatch: the regiment is released from service. He addresses it to the dead because he has no right to demand that the living forgive him yet.

Donate 16 stone bricks and 4 lanterns for a regimental memorial. You may place a memorial in the world; completion checks the donation.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: A Captain without a Crown
quests.story:
The remaining scouts ask Elian to stay. This time he accepts their trust instead of a royal commission. Ysolde's map arrives with news of a dragon that remembers the covenant's beginning.

Enter "no orders beyond conscience" to record the new company oath and open the dragon expedition.

quests.title: 19 | The Cartographer of Bones
quests.story:
A dragon hunter named Ysolde sends a map with all the safe routes crossed out. "The map is accurate," she writes. "It is the world that has become unreasonable."

Acquire an Explorer's Compass. Use its available structure search to plan expeditions; Ice and Fire dragon roosts may still require ordinary exploration.

quests.title: 20 | The Shepherd's Giant
quests.story:
Ysolde will share her dragon research only after the road to her coastal camp is safe. A cyclops has made a larder of the pass.

Defeat one Ice and Fire cyclops. Prepare range, escape routes, and healing before approaching its territory.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the shepherd's giant with Ysolde. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the shepherd's giant with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: Protect the threatened people and record the harm. A frightened village deserves both practical help and an honest explanation.

quests.title: 21 | A Pact with the Flame
quests.story:
Sera burns a test page from the covenant. The letters survive ordinary fire. Dragonfire will burn hotter, and you must live long enough to see what it reveals.

Gain the Fire Resistance effect before your hunt. Potions or another valid source of minecraft:fire_resistance count. This quest does not promise protection from every modded attack.

quests.title: 22 | The Red Witness
quests.story:
The fire dragon remembers the first king, or so Ysolde believes. It guards the scar where his soldiers stole the flame that sealed the bargain. You go there as the heir to their debt.

Defeat one Ice and Fire fire dragon. Any stage that credits the fire_dragon kill counts. Bring serious equipment; this is the first major expedition boss.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the red witness with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the red witness with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The account stays beside what we can verify. Neither certainty nor disbelief should be added to simplify the story.

quests.title: 23 | The Ash Between the Letters
quests.story:
In the dragon's heat the ledger reveals its hidden line: "The furnace keeps the bodies. The crypt keeps the names." The monarchy was a machine for making death useful.

Gather 10 obsidian and a flint and steel for the descent. The fire dragon's heart is yours to use; no rare drop is consumed by the story.

quests.title: 24 | The Cinder Gate
quests.story:
Rowan gives you the camp's oldest lantern. "Find a way back," the letter says. "Winning is not enough if nobody comes home."

Enter the Nether and complete We Need to Go Deeper. Mark your portal and bring spare supplies before proceeding.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the cinder gate with Mara. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the cinder gate with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Check the return route before trusting the threshold. A way in is half the equipment needed for an expedition.

quests.title: A Sound through the Portal
quests.section: IV.b | The Toll of the Nameless
quests.story:
The portal brings back more than heat. At sunset a bell sounds in Sera's dreams, followed by names she has never read. She thinks the furnace has a ledger of its own.

Acquire 16 quartz and 8 glowstone dust to study the resonance. Gather them during cautious Nether exploration.

quests.title: The Foundry Listening Post
quests.section: IV.b | The Toll of the Nameless
quests.story:
Mara sketches a receiver that owes as much to superstition as engineering. She promises only that it will survive the experiment.

Acquire a lodestone. The netherite investment makes this a substantial preparation milestone; keep it for navigation afterward.

quests.title: A Bell without a Tower
quests.section: IV.b | The Toll of the Nameless
quests.story:
Sera finds an old funeral rite whose instrument was never meant to ring in daylight.

Acquire Meet Your Fight's Haunted Bell. Its installed recipe uses gold ingots and cobbled deepslate; see JEI for the exact pattern.

quests.title: The Dead Air between Notes
quests.section: IV.b | The Toll of the Nameless
quests.story:
Fen listens to the receiver and asks that you never turn it on near the hospital. You choose an isolated place where the answering presence cannot reach the refuge.

Acquire a shield and 16 golden carrots for the encounter. Choosing a safe arena is your responsibility; this quest checks equipment and food.

quests.title: The Bellringer's Answer
quests.section: IV.b | The Toll of the Nameless
quests.story:
The Bellringer arrives as if it has been expected for centuries. Every stroke sounds like a tally mark closing over a name.

Use the Haunted Bell through Meet Your Fight's normal summoning mechanics and defeat the Bellringer.

quests.title: The Name after the Echo
quests.section: IV.b | The Toll of the Nameless
quests.story:
In the silence Sera hears one clear phrase: the accounts are balanced below. The Nether furnace is not a metaphor.

Complete the vanilla Subspace Bubble advancement: travel far enough through the Nether to achieve its Overworld-distance requirement. Build a safe return route rather than rushing blind.

quests.title: Provision the Descent
quests.section: IV.b | The Toll of the Nameless
quests.story:
Tamsin sees your new route and counts how far it is from help. Her supply list is more persuasive than any warning.

Donate 16 bread and 16 coal to establish a relay store. Carry your own separate expedition supplies.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: Where the Accounts Balance
quests.section: IV.b | The Toll of the Nameless
quests.story:
Elian posts a copy of the missing names by the portal. Whatever waits below will have to answer to people, not numbers.

Acquire a brewing stand and 8 magma cream for sustained fire-protection preparation. The fortress campaign begins next.

quests.title: 25 | The Garrison Below
quests.story:
Elian recognizes the plan of a Nether fortress from the old capital's military academy. The king copied more than architecture from the world below.

Find a Nether fortress and earn A Terrible Fortress. Incendium and fortress overhauls can make the journey dangerous; retreating to re-equip is part of the expedition.

quests.title: 26 | Fuel for a Dead Kingdom
quests.story:
Sera's sketches show blaze rods turning the royal furnace. Every delivery to the crypt had a matching entry here. Sever the supply and take what you need to survive the next descent.

Collect 8 blaze rods and 16 nether wart. Preserve enough to brew your own expedition supplies.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the dead kingdom's fuel with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the dead kingdom's fuel with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Reserve what the living settlement needs first. Rebuilding one promise must not quietly break another.

quests.title: 27 | Iron That Refuses to Die
quests.story:
Mara studies a sliver of ancient debris. "Even the king could not make iron immortal," she writes. "But he found something close." The forge's guardian is built from it.

Acquire 2 ancient debris. This material study can be completed alongside the fortress supply mission.

quests.title: 28 | The Furnace's Eye
quests.story:
The last page of Ysolde's map carries a circle of molten iron. Within it waits the engine that armed a century of wars.

Acquire Cataclysm's Monstrous Eye. Consult its recipe in JEI and use it to seek the Soul Black Smith. Prepare a strong loadout before entering.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the furnace's eye with Mara. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the furnace's eye with Mara
objectives.dialogue: We can examine the mechanism without restoring its old purpose. Inventory its dangerous parts carefully.

quests.title: 29 | Break the Royal Engine
quests.story:
The Netherite Monstrosity rises from the furnace. Its metal bears the old sun seal, hammered so many times it has become a wound. Break the thing that kept the king's bargain supplied.

Defeat Cataclysm's Netherite Monstrosity. Bring fire protection, healing, and a planned retreat. The quest tracks the boss kill, not a particular weapon.

quests.title: 30 | The Names in the Cinders
quests.story:
When the furnace falls silent, Sera finds names in its accounts: soldiers, debtors, children. Among them is Rowan's missing brother. The dead king did not forget his people. He inventoried them.

Return your attention to the living: donate 24 bread and 8 gold ingots to Dawnstead's relief fund. Make the journey home when you are ready; the turn-in itself can be claimed anywhere.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the names in the cinders with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the names in the cinders with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Copy legible names and mark uncertain letters. A guess must not become someone's identity because readers cannot see our doubt.

quests.title: The Archive That Would Not Burn
quests.story:
Among the furnace records is a payment to a northern monastery. Its librarians stored the king's first contract in ice because parchment could no longer be trusted.

Acquire 16 leather and 16 white wool for a northern expedition. These are supply milestones, not a simulated temperature system.

quests.title: The Mountain Rescue Fund
quests.story:
Rowan sends food ahead of the expedition. The northern settlements should not have to choose between feeding you and feeding themselves.

Donate 24 baked potatoes and 12 honey bottles to the relief fund.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: A Map of White Places
quests.story:
Iona cannot guarantee a short route. She can guarantee that every safe stopping place will be recorded before the company moves on.

Acquire a Waystones warp stone and 16 ender pearls. Use the travel network available in your instance; owning these does not activate a waypoint automatically.

quests.title: The Silence in the Pass
quests.story:
The monastery's approach lies in Frostmaw territory. Ysolde advises patience: the northern silence is sometimes asleep rather than empty.

Defeat Mowzie's Mobs' Frostmaw. Your earlier optional victory counts if it was tracked.

quests.title: The Cabinet of Last Words
quests.story:
Inside the surviving records, the king's first subjects describe the covenant as a rescue. The later entries use a different word: ransom.

Acquire 16 bookshelves and 4 lecterns to house the recovered testimony. Place them at your archive if desired; the tracked check is inventory.

quests.title: The Dragon over the Scriptorium
quests.story:
An ice dragon has claimed the librarians' final refuge. The old contract lies somewhere under its territory, beyond the reach of ordinary couriers.

Defeat one Ice and Fire ice dragon. Prepare cold-resistant tactics appropriate to your installed equipment and the encounter.

quests.title: A Kingdom Remembered Incorrectly
quests.story:
Sera compares the northern testimonies with the official history. The golden age lasted only because its victims were removed from the record.

Donate 12 paper and 8 ink sacs to publish the recovered testimonies before another ruler can suppress them.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The King's True Address
quests.story:
The witnesses agree on one detail: the king stopped aging when he moved his court into the crypt. Sera closes the atlas at the catacombs, and Rowan asks you to finish the accounting.

Enter "no name will be erased" to commit the testimony to the public archive. The journey to the Dead King resumes.

objectives.label: Write: no name will be erased

quests.title: 31 | The Door without a Key
quests.section: VI. The King Who Would Not Die
quests.story:
Sera learns why the king collected relic eyes: the final witness waits beyond a door that refuses ordinary keys.

Gather 16 ender pearls. Continue The Lost Eyes | NPC Trials with the named companions. The first twelve trials award the distinct End Remastered keys required before the Spire portal assignment. Sera begins the chain after The First Hearth. The Explorer Journal remains an optional record of eyes obtained, including quest rewards.

An End portal frame already exists at the Spire. Save your eyes for that frame; no stronghold search is required.

quests.title: 32 | A Record of the Dead
quests.section: VI. The King Who Would Not Die
quests.story:
The crypt's location appears in an account older than the current kingdom. Whoever sits inside has borrowed many names. Sera needs a working archive before she dares translate the oldest one.

Acquire 12 bookshelves and 16 amethyst shards. Search Iron's Spellbooks catacombs during your wider expeditions; Explorer's Compass may help locate the structure.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the record of the dead with Tamsin. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the record of the dead with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Let families decide what belongs in public. Remembering someone does not give us every detail of their life.

quests.title: 33 | The King Who Would Not Die
quests.section: VI. The King Who Would Not Die
quests.story:
The Dead King calls you an ungrateful subject. He says every life he took bought one more year of peace. Rowan's reply is short: "Then the debt ends with you."

Defeat the Dead King from Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks in the catacombs. Resolve the encounter fully so the boss death is credited.

quests.title: 34 | What the Crown Could Not Keep
quests.section: VI. The King Who Would Not Die
quests.story:
There is no lost heir to rescue, no rightful claimant in hiding. The throne is empty. Sera proposes that it remain that way until the people who paid for it can decide its fate.

Enter "the debt ends" in the text field to record the council's decision. Finish the first twelve NPC eye trials before approaching the Spire portal; Rowan holds the twelfth key. Four further trials offer optional extra eyes.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss what the crown left behind with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss what the crown left behind with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Useful buildings may remain. The old claims of obedience do not become ours because we hold their keys.

quests.title: 35 | The Portal at the Spire
quests.section: VI. The King Who Would Not Die
quests.story:
An End portal frame already stands at the Spire. You do not need to locate a stronghold or build another frame.

Complete the first twelve NPC eye trials, then discuss the portal preparations with the Spire Guard. The trials award twelve distinct End Remastered eyes directly. Keep those keys for the existing frame at the Spire; this quest does not consume them. Four further NPC trials offer additional eyes. Existing End Remastered sources remain available for replacements. Return to Eldara for the final expedition preparations before crossing.
quests.aftermath: The Spire Guard confirms the portal plan. Eldara has the final supply and return preparations.

objectives.label: Discuss the existing portal at the Spire with the Spire Guard
objectives.dialogue: The End portal frame is already here at the Spire. Bring your twelve distinct quest-earned eyes to this frame; there is no need to search for a stronghold. Finish Eldara's expedition preparations before you open the portal and cross.

quests.title: 36 | A Sky without Dawn
quests.section: VI. The King Who Would Not Die
quests.story:
The portal answers. On the other side there is no sunrise to promise you a second chance. You carry the letters from Dawnstead in a dry pocket.

Use the End portal frame already at the Spire. Open it using End Remastered's rules and enter the End. Earn The End? Bring empty bottles for dragon breath, building blocks, ranged attacks, and a way to handle falls.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the sky without dawn with Iona. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the sky without dawn with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The return route and conflicting readings are marked. Take both the map and its warnings to Eldara.

quests.title: The Last Camp in the World
quests.section: VI.b | The Company at the Last Gate
quests.story:
The existing End portal frame at the Spire is our crossing point, but the council refuses to send another expedition without a return plan. Elian asks each companion to name something worth surviving for.

Acquire 2 ender chests so you can build a supply link on both sides of the journey. Keep the chests; placement is up to you.

quests.title: Mara's Final Fitting
quests.section: VI.b | The Company at the Last Gate
quests.story:
Mara will not insist on a favorite weapon. She insists that you test a complete set of serious protection before crossing.

Acquire netherite boots and a diamond helmet. These are gear milestones, not mandatory combat equipment.

quests.title: Tamsin's Return Kit
quests.section: VI.b | The Company at the Last Gate
quests.story:
Tamsin labels the box RETURN rather than EMERGENCY. She says the difference is important and declines to explain it.

Acquire 16 golden carrots and 8 phantom membranes for travel and potion preparation. Check JEI for your available fall-protection options.

quests.title: The Council beneath Stone
quests.section: VI.b | The Company at the Last Gate
quests.story:
The supply officers are ready. Sera now asks the company to make one agreement: nothing found beyond the portal grants ownership of the people left behind.

Enter "we return as equals" in the text field. This is a fixed story commitment rather than a branching faction choice.

quests.title: A Room for the Returned
quests.section: VI.b | The Company at the Last Gate
quests.story:
Rowan prepares beds in the infirmary and refuses to discuss whether all of them will be needed.

Donate 16 white wool, 16 glass bottles, and 16 bread to the return station.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Last Watch
quests.section: VI.b | The Company at the Last Gate
quests.story:
Elian asks you to prove you can hold a night watch before the expedition leaves the Spire.

Reach 24 zombie kills, then return to Eldara. Earlier kills count. The End portal frame already stands at the Spire; this preparation does not require a stronghold expedition.

quests.title: A Map beyond Maps
quests.section: VI.b | The Company at the Last Gate
quests.story:
Iona hands you blank sheets. There is no point pretending that an old map can describe a place nobody has returned from.

Acquire 32 scaffolding and 8 glass bottles for the End expedition. Carry additional blocks and ranged supplies of your choosing.

quests.title: Leave the Lantern Burning
quests.section: VI.b | The Company at the Last Gate
quests.story:
Fen volunteers for the last watch outside the portal. His instructions are to wait, not to follow. For once, a heroic story has given somebody permission to stay safe.

Acquire 4 ender pearls and a water bucket for your final readiness check, then proceed to A Sky without Dawn.

quests.title: 37 | The Last Witness
quests.story:
The dragon circles the ruined island like a thought that cannot end. It witnessed the covenant's making. It will not willingly witness its undoing.

Defeat the Ender Dragon and complete Free the End. Bottle some dragon breath while the opportunity is available, or return for a respawned fight later.

quests.title: 38 | The Breath of an Old Oath
quests.story:
Sera warned you that killing a witness does not erase a bargain. Its last breath holds the wording she needs to break it.

Hold 4 bottles of dragon breath. The bottles are kept. If you missed them, use the normal Ender Dragon resummoning process and collect its lingering breath.

quests.title: 39 | Islands of Exile
quests.story:
Beyond the gateway stand cities built for people who never came home. Their empty towers offer a warning: survival is not the same as a life.

Find an End city and complete The City at the End of the Game. Explore the outer islands carefully; this quest does not require a ship or Elytra drop.

quests.title: 40 | The Eye of the Gaoler
quests.story:
A citadel stands apart from the cities. Its guardian did not serve the king; it kept him to his word. With the king dead, it will hold the living realm responsible instead.

Acquire Cataclysm's Void Eye and use it to seek the Ruined Citadel. Check JEI for the recipe and return home for better equipment if needed.

quests.title: 41 | The Warden of the Empty Throne
quests.story:
The Ender Guardian moves as the citadel crumbles. You do not fight for a throne. You fight for everyone who was never asked to sign the covenant.

Defeat Cataclysm's Ender Guardian. Clear enough of the approach to recover safely if you fall.

quests.title: 42 | Letters from Home
quests.story:
Rowan's newest letter contains no requests. A child has drawn Dawnstead beneath a yellow sun. For the first time, the page looks forward rather than back.

Donate 16 paper and 4 books to preserve the names recovered from the covenant. Return to your refuge before continuing if you want to close the journey there.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: 43 | The Last Debt
quests.section: VIII. A Crown for No One
quests.story:
Sera discovers a final clause: destroying the wardens releases the covenant's gathered death. It needs a vessel before it can be dispersed. The ritual is represented by a Wither battle, not a scripted world event.

Gather 3 wither skeleton skulls and 4 soul sand. Prepare a distant, controlled arena before summoning the Wither; keep it away from Dawnstead and any colony.

quests.title: 44 | The Shape of All Our Sorrows
quests.section: VIII. A Crown for No One
quests.story:
Three voices become one scream. The old debt finally has a body, and a body can be defeated. This time you know exactly what you are fighting for.

Defeat one Wither. Your modpack may alter this encounter; prepare accordingly. The tracked entity is minecraft:wither.

quests.title: 45 | A Light That Asks for Nothing
quests.section: VIII. A Crown for No One
quests.story:
Mara takes the star and sketches a beacon. The king used light to demand obedience. Dawnstead will use it to help lost travelers find shelter.

Acquire a beacon. Keep it to build a working monument at your refuge.

quests.title: 46 | Raise the Dawn
quests.section: VIII. A Crown for No One
quests.story:
The beacon shines over roofs built by people who expected to die. Rowan hangs the first relief ledger beside it, open to the page where your name arrived.

Build and activate a beacon to earn Bring Home the Beacon. The previous reward supplies a minimum one-layer iron base; clear the beam's path.

quests.title: 47 | A Crown for No One
quests.section: VIII. A Crown for No One
quests.story:
Elian lays down his commission. Sera seals the old contract in the archive. Rowan refuses a throne, and Mara melts its last fitting into a door hinge. You decide that the new realm will belong to the people who keep it alive.

Enter "the dawn belongs to everyone" to sign Dawnstead's charter. This closes the main conflict and opens the final celebration.

objectives.label: Write: the dawn belongs to everyone

quests.title: 48 | The First Ordinary Morning - Book I Finale
quests.section: VIII. A Crown for No One
quests.story:
No army appears at sunrise. There is bread, a quarrel over a fence, and a child asking about the next festival. You have won the right to an ordinary morning. BOOK I COMPLETE. The neighboring provinces, however, still need roads, food, and a place in the new peace. Rowan has received their first delegation.

Donate one cake for the celebration and claim this reward. Continue in Book II: The Unwritten Kingdoms, starting with The Second Ledger. Optional factions remain open.

Turn-in: the cake is consumed on claim.

quests.title: The Second Ledger
quests.section: IX | The Price of the Dawn
quests.story:
The festival ends with an unexpected delegation. Neighboring provinces used the king's roads, granaries, and defenses. Breaking his covenant freed them from tribute, but also left them exposed. Rowan asks what responsibility freedom carries.

Acquire 8 writable books and 16 emeralds to prepare the provincial council. You keep these supplies; the council is narrated through the journal.

quests.title: The Granaries of a Free Realm
quests.section: IX | The Price of the Dawn
quests.story:
The first delegate asks for soldiers. Tamsin asks how many people the province can feed this winter. Nobody enjoys the answer.

Donate 32 bread, 32 carrots, and 16 cooked beef to the interprovincial relief fund. Renewable food production will support the longer campaign.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Machine beneath the Charter
quests.section: IX | The Price of the Dawn
quests.story:
Mara discovers that an automated arsenal continues issuing royal equipment to anyone carrying the old seal. A dead king can still purchase a civil war.

Acquire Cataclysm's Mech Eye and 16 redstone. Consult JEI for the locator recipe and prepare to explore the Ancient Factory.

quests.title: No More Automatic Wars
quests.section: IX | The Price of the Dawn
quests.story:
The delegates agree to a shared armory, but only if someone removes the machine that decides which towns deserve weapons. Elian refuses to let another decision be made by an inherited order.

Defeat 4 Cataclysm Watchers in the factory expedition. These are the_watcher entities, not projectiles or decorative machines.

quests.title: The Warrant That Never Expired
quests.section: IX | The Price of the Dawn
quests.story:
The Harbinger presents an authorization older than Dawnstead. It recognizes every kingdom that has died and none of the people who are still alive.

Activate and defeat Cataclysm's Harbinger using the installed encounter rules. Bring its required activation material and prepare for ranged attacks.

quests.title: The Foundry Belongs to Everyone
quests.section: IX | The Price of the Dawn
quests.story:
Mara proposes melting the royal seals into standardized tools. The delegates would prefer their own crests. She invites them to forge those themselves.

Donate 24 iron ingots and 16 copper ingots for a civilian tool reserve. The factory's fictional political control changes in the story only.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: Three Provinces, One Table
quests.section: IX | The Price of the Dawn
quests.story:
The desert delegation claims its trade route is oldest. The coast claims it is most important. Rowan orders a larger table rather than choosing a winner.

Acquire 8 lecterns and 16 lanterns for the provincial hall. Build a council chamber if you enjoy settlement design; the quest tracks supplies.

quests.title: A Charter with Empty Seats
quests.section: IX | The Price of the Dawn
quests.story:
Two seats remain empty: the Sunken Coast and the Glass March. Their envoys never arrived. Elian offers two expedition plans and asks you which road you want to take first.

Enter "no province left unheard". The desert and ocean chapters now open in parallel; both must be resolved before the northern council.

quests.title: The Toll on an Empty Well
quests.story:
A desert courier explains the new tax: nobody may draw water without swearing loyalty to a king who has been dead for centuries. A familiar bargain has found unfamiliar masters.

Acquire Cataclysm's Desert Eye and 8 water buckets. Plan a desert expedition; the buckets are an inventory milestone, not a thirst mechanic.

quests.title: Water for the Unsworn
quests.story:
The oasis keepers will guide you if you first help families who refused the oath. Rowan sends the supplies without demanding loyalty in return.

Donate 24 glass bottles and 24 melon slices to the displaced families.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Script beneath the Sand
quests.story:
Sera finds the old court's seal in a much older desert inscription. Your king copied his covenant; he did not invent it.

Acquire 4 brushes and 16 paper for an archaeological survey. Keep the tools; explore the desert's ruins as your world generates them.

quests.title: The Guards of a Buried Border
quests.story:
The Cursed Pyramid still treats travelers as trespassers. Its soldiers have no orders for recognizing a foreign council.

Defeat 12 Cataclysm koboletons during the pyramid expedition. Their exact registered target is cataclysm:koboleton.

quests.title: The Sandstone Champion
quests.story:
A Kobolediator guards the deeper route. The envoy's broken spear lies within sight of its post. Elian asks you to recover a passage rather than avenge a symbol.

Defeat one Cataclysm Kobolediator. Prepare for the pyramid's other defenders before starting the encounter.

quests.title: The King Who Was a Monument
quests.story:
The Ancient Remnant rises in a court built entirely to remember its power. The people outside remember only the price of water.

Defeat Cataclysm's Ancient Remnant. Use the installed pyramid encounter mechanics and prepare for the full boss fight.

quests.title: The Wells Open at Dawn
quests.story:
The oasis keepers remove the royal seal from the well. For a moment nobody steps forward; freedom is an unfamiliar rule.

Donate 32 sandstone and 16 iron ingots for well repairs. The story opens the wells; this pack does not alter generated structures automatically.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The March Chooses Its Delegate
quests.story:
The oasis keepers send a water carrier to the council. He arrives without a crown, carrying an accurate list of what his neighbors need.

Acquire a decorated pot and 8 emeralds for the March's charter gift. Finish the coast chapter as well to convene the next council.

quests.title: The Harbor That Sank Twice
quests.story:
Fen once traded in the Sunken Coast. The sea took its walls first; isolation took its government afterward. The survivors now live by salvage and contradictory maps.

Acquire Cataclysm's Abyss Eye and a conduit. Use the locator to plan a Sunken City expedition and prepare reliable underwater survival.

quests.title: The Shipwright's Bargain
quests.story:
The surviving shipwright offers passage for every delegate if Dawnstead supplies timber before asking for favors.

Donate 48 spruce logs and 16 iron ingots for a common ferry. Exact spruce logs are requested.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Healer below the Waterline
quests.story:
Tamsin refuses to trust a single breathing potion to an entire expedition. She wants a tested fallback before anyone swims into a ruin.

Gain Water Breathing and acquire a turtle helmet. The helmet is an equipment milestone; use your strongest actual diving setup.

quests.title: The Priests of the Undertow
quests.story:
The sunken streets have new keepers. Fen recognizes none of their prayers, but recognizes the fear in the stranded sailors' reports.

Defeat 8 Cataclysm deeplings and 2 deepling priests. The journal tracks those exact entities, not every sea creature.

quests.title: The Offering Nobody Wanted
quests.story:
The old city kept a ritual offering against the day its guardian woke hungry. Sera asks that you learn the ritual before choosing to awaken it.

Acquire Cataclysm's Abyssal Sacrifice. Check its installed recipe and altar use in JEI and the mod's guide; retain it for the encounter.

quests.title: The Debt beneath the Sea
quests.story:
The Leviathan answers the altar. The drowned council once called it protection. Fen has seen enough wrecks to ask protection from whom.

Summon and defeat Cataclysm's Leviathan. Prepare for its underwater arena and do not fight beside settlements you want to preserve.

quests.title: Soundings for a New Harbor
quests.story:
Iona and Fen chart routes by measuring what is there, not what a dead admiral ordered them to expect. The first revised chart is ugly and useful.

Donate 24 paper and 16 prismarine shards to the coastal restoration fund.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Republic Sends a Boat
quests.story:
The coast elects a navigator to the council. Her first act is to offer passage to the desert delegate, who has never seen an ocean.

Acquire a sea lantern and a compass for the shared navigation hall. Complete the Glass March too; both delegations are needed for the next chapter.

quests.title: The Envoy in Chains
quests.story:
With the coast and desert seated, the council receives a northern envoy carrying his own arrest warrant. His province's laws still treat departure as desertion.

Acquire Cataclysm's Cursed Eye and 16 leather to prepare for the Frosted Prison expedition.

quests.title: A Winter without Hostages
quests.story:
Rowan discovers that families are held responsible for each other's debts. The council begins with the practical work of feeding those who escape.

Donate 32 baked potatoes and 24 white wool to the northern relief stations.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Law in Plain Words
quests.story:
Sera translates the prison charter. Its elaborate language conceals a simple rule: the ruler is never wrong. She prepares a public copy in words a child can understand.

Donate 12 books and 16 ink sacs for translations. This can be completed alongside the supply mission.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Prison Still Has Guards
quests.story:
The outer defenses still enforce a sentence on everyone who approaches. Elian does not expect them to recognize the council's authority.

Defeat 8 Cataclysm draugr and 3 elite draugr while exploring the northern structures.

quests.title: The Executioner's Hall
quests.story:
An Aptrgangr keeps the passage to the prison's master. Sera finds no record of its trials, only a list of sentences.

Defeat one Cataclysm Aptrgangr. Learn the encounter and clear a recovery route before pressing deeper.

quests.title: The Sentence without an End
quests.story:
Maledictus has turned punishment into a kingdom. You cannot persuade a curse to apologize, but you can stop letting it govern the living.

Defeat Cataclysm's Maledictus using the Frosted Prison encounter mechanics.

quests.title: The Doors Open Outward
quests.story:
Mara insists that the new court's doors must open from the inside without a key. The northern envoy writes the requirement into the building plan.

Donate 16 oak doors and 16 lanterns for civic rebuilding. Their placement is an optional building project; the quest checks the donation.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: A Law That Binds Its Authors
quests.story:
The northern delegate takes her seat with a proposal: every law must apply to the people who write it. The council argues until midnight and then signs.

Enter "the law binds its authors" to ratify the agreement. The remaining war faction will answer with fire.

objectives.label: Write: the law binds its authors

quests.title: A Crown Offered Twice
quests.story:
A loyalist messenger offers Elian command of a restored royal army. Elian sends the commission to the public archive unopened. The messenger burns the council's reply.

Acquire Cataclysm's Flame Eye and 16 gold ingots for an expedition to the Burning Arena.

quests.title: The Price of a Safe Return
quests.story:
Tamsin prepares the largest medical shipment since the marsh fever. She does not ask you to promise victory, only to stop treating injuries as proof of courage.

Donate 24 glass bottles and 16 honey bottles for the campaign hospital.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Armor That Outlasts Orders
quests.story:
Mara studies the guardian fragments and offers one more practical lesson: a good breastplate cannot decide whether the person inside serves a good cause.

Acquire a netherite chestplate and 4 golden apples. Use your preferred modded armor during the actual fight if it serves you better.

quests.title: The Ashen Honor Guard
quests.story:
The arena's revenants still parade beneath a banner whose kingdom has vanished. They recognize no surrender but destruction.

Defeat 3 Cataclysm Ignited Revenants. Gather the resources needed for the subsequent altar encounter.

quests.title: The Flame of a Dead Promise
quests.story:
Sera has learned the final loyalist rite. It calls not for a new king but for someone willing to burn the world until the old one returns.

Acquire a Cataclysm Burning Ashes offering. Verify the altar recipe and use before proceeding; this item is kept for the boss summon.

quests.title: The Knight Who Could Not Kneel
quests.story:
Ignis stands beneath the arena's broken sun. Elian recognizes the posture of someone who has turned obedience into the last defense against grief.

Summon and defeat Cataclysm's Ignis. This is a late campaign boss; finish optional equipment paths first if needed.

quests.title: An Armory for the Unarmed
quests.story:
Elian refuses to inherit the loyalist ranks. Mara turns the expedition's profits toward tools, hinges, and wagon fittings.

Donate 32 iron ingots and 16 copper ingots to the civilian workshops. The victory should leave something useful behind.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Invitation in Violet
quests.story:
At the next council meeting a violet flower appears inside a sealed book. Sera recognizes the crest of a court that existed before the first covenant. Someone has been watching the new realm learn to govern itself.

Acquire Meet Your Fight's Dusk Key. The installed recipe uses blackstone, amethyst, diamond, and an allium; consult JEI for the pattern.

quests.title: The Garden behind the History
quests.section: XIV | A Kingdom without a Master
quests.story:
The invitation promises a perfect realm without hunger, dispute, or change. Rowan reads it twice before noticing that it never mentions people making choices.

Acquire a golden apple, an allium, and a writable book to record the last delegation's terms. No custom garden structure is generated by this quest.

quests.title: Sera's Unfinished Book
quests.section: XIV | A Kingdom without a Master
quests.story:
Sera asks every delegate to contribute one failure to the official history. A realm that cannot admit a mistake will eventually repeat the old king's bargain.

Donate 16 books and 24 paper for the public history. This work can proceed alongside the council's beacon project.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: A Light Seen from Every Road
quests.section: XIV | A Kingdom without a Master
quests.story:
The provinces agree to expand Dawnstead's beacon. Each insists that its workers should help build it. For once their competition produces something generous.

Build a full-size beacon pyramid and earn Beaconator. Use any valid mixture of beacon-base blocks; this is a substantial communal construction milestone.

quests.title: The Offer of Perfect Peace
quests.section: XIV | A Kingdom without a Master
quests.story:
The ancient court offers to remove every difficult choice the council has faced. Elian calls it the same covenant written in kinder ink.

Enter "peace must leave us free" to refuse the offer. This is the campaign's fixed position, not a promise of dynamically branching world states.

objectives.label: Write: peace must leave us free

quests.title: The Lady of the Closed Garden
quests.section: XIV | A Kingdom without a Master
quests.story:
Rosalyne answers the refusal. In the journal's telling, she guards the beautiful certainty the council has rejected. You fight for an imperfect future that remains open.

Use the Dusk Key through Meet Your Fight's normal mechanics and defeat Rosalyne. Complete all phases so the final kill is credited.

quests.title: The Last Emergency Ledger
quests.section: XIV | A Kingdom without a Master
quests.story:
Tamsin closes the campaign hospital's book. She leaves it within reach; a free world will still contain accidents, winters, and people who need help.

Donate 16 bread, 16 honey bottles, and 8 golden carrots for a permanent public dispensary.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Seats Stay Empty
quests.section: XIV | A Kingdom without a Master
quests.story:
The council reserves chairs for settlements it has not yet met. Fen offers ships, Iona offers maps, and Sera leaves room in the charter for corrections.

Acquire 8 maps and 8 compasses for the next generation of envoys. These are blank maps; choose the regions you want to chart yourself.

quests.title: The Unwritten Kingdoms
quests.section: XIV | A Kingdom without a Master
quests.story:
Rowan finds your first relief letter in the archive. The seal is broken and the paper smoke-stained. Beneath the plea for a light, a new hand has added: "We kept it burning." THE ASHEN COVENANT II: COMPLETE. The roads, companions, and unfinished discoveries now belong to you.

Enter "we kept it burning" to sign the final chronicle. The first two books are complete. Book III: The Hollow Concord now awaits you. Optional factions, mastery trials, and contracts remain available.

quests.title: A Blade without a Master
quests.story:
Elian offers you a place among the Unsworn, knights who protect roads rather than bloodlines.

Acquire a Simply Swords iron longsword. You may still use another weapon in combat.

quests.title: The Patient Shield
quests.story:
A veteran teaches you to hear the bowstring before looking for the arrow. Courage begins with staying alive.

Earn Not Today, Thank You by blocking a projectile with a shield.

quests.title: An Oath at the Crossroads
quests.story:
A village cannot afford a garrison. The Unsworn promise to make the raiders fear the road instead.

Defeat 16 pillagers total. Previous kills count toward this milestone.

quests.title: The Hollow Champion
quests.story:
A mutant skeleton wears the fragments of several fallen soldiers. Elian asks that you put all of them to rest.

Defeat one Mutant Monsters mutant skeleton. This optional hunt can wait until you have strong equipment.

quests.title: The Knight Who Forgot His Name
quests.story:
Deep beneath stone, the Ferrous Wroughtnaut still guards a doorway whose builders are dust. Elian sees his own future in its endless duty.

Defeat Mowzie's Mobs' Ferrous Wroughtnaut. Watch its attack cycle and openings. Your knighthood ends with freedom from a master, not a new title.

quests.title: A String and a Promise
quests.story:
Scout Iona leaves a bowstring in your supplies. "The road is longer than your sword," her note says.

Acquire a bow and 32 arrows. Practice from a position with a clear retreat before taking them into a ruin.

quests.title: Eyes on the Ridge
quests.story:
Iona maps dangers before she maps destinations. Learning what not to approach is half her profession.

Acquire a spyglass and a compass. Use them to survey the next expedition route.

quests.title: The First Clean Shot
quests.story:
An arrow loosed in panic saves no one. Iona asks for patience, distance, and one deliberate shot.

Earn Take Aim by shooting a hostile target with a bow and arrow.

quests.title: Nobody Walks Alone
quests.story:
The scout admits that the best listener in her company has four legs. A road companion need not speak to keep you grounded.

Tame an animal and earn Best Friends Forever. Keep it safe during boss expeditions.

quests.title: The Thing above the Cliffs
quests.story:
A naga has driven travelers from Iona's cliff road. She asks you to reclaim the sky before another caravan attempts the crossing.

Defeat one Mowzie's Mobs naga. Bring ranged options and avoid fighting over a fatal drop.

quests.title: Permission to Wonder
quests.story:
Sera has reopened the college without its old entrance examination. The first lesson is that magic belongs to anyone willing to study it.

Acquire Iron's Spellbooks' copper spell book. Check JEI for the recipe and spell inscription process.

quests.title: A Desk for Impossible Things
quests.story:
The old college demanded marble towers. Sera begins with a desk and enough light to read by.

Acquire an inscription table and 4 common ink. These remain yours to use.

quests.title: The Margin between Worlds
quests.story:
Your notes begin to contradict the official histories. Sera encourages you to keep the contradictions; they are where discovery lives.

Acquire 2 uncommon ink and 24 arcane essence.

quests.title: Theory under Pressure
quests.story:
A cryomancer is freezing the old research route. The college needs someone who can take a theory outside and bring it back alive.

Defeat an Iron's Spellbooks cryomancer. Learn the encounter before committing your best supplies.

quests.title: A College with Open Doors
quests.story:
Sera hangs your annotated spellbook in the library beside the charter: knowledge may be dangerous, but ignorance is no defense.

Acquire a gold spell book and an arcane anvil. Build your preferred spell loadout; the quest does not require particular spells or spell NBT.

quests.title: Something Other than a Sword
quests.story:
Healer Tamsin counts victories in people who return to work. She asks you to begin a proper field dispensary.

Acquire a brewing stand and 12 glass bottles. Keep a separate chest for ingredients so the dispensary is ready before an expedition.

quests.title: The First Good Batch
quests.story:
Tamsin labels every bottle. Heroism is a poor excuse for handing someone the wrong potion.

Brew a potion and earn Local Brewery. Keep your useful potions for travel.

quests.title: A Heartbeat Returned
quests.story:
A scout arrives too wounded to speak. Tamsin works while you hold the lamp, then insists you learn the same art.

Gain the Regeneration effect. Any valid source of minecraft:regeneration counts.

quests.title: Breath for the Drowned Road
quests.story:
The old coastal road lies underwater. Tamsin can give its travelers time, if you can prove the preparation works.

Gain Water Breathing. Test it somewhere safe before using it on a deep expedition.

quests.title: The Patient with No Name
quests.story:
Everyone else calls the infected villager a monster. Tamsin leaves a blank line in her register and waits for a name.

Cure a zombie villager and earn Zombie Doctor. Protect the patient throughout the cure.

quests.title: The Surveyor's Peg
quests.story:
Rowan asks what Dawnstead might become if people stopped thinking of it as a camp. A town hall is a promise to keep records of the living.

Complete MineColonies' build town hall advancement. Follow its normal colony creation process; merely holding a hut block does not count.

quests.title: Hands to Build It
quests.story:
Mara is delighted to find a builder who argues with her plans. A town will need more than one stubborn craftsperson.

Complete the MineColonies build builder advancement.

quests.title: A Roof with a Name
quests.story:
The first permanent resident asks whether the room is truly theirs. Rowan gives them the key instead of an answer.

Complete the MineColonies build citizen residence advancement.

quests.title: The Watch Comes Home
quests.story:
Elian orders the guards to learn the residents' names before they learn parade drills. This is a place to defend, not occupy.

Complete the MineColonies build guard tower advancement.

quests.title: The Sound of Ordinary Voices
quests.story:
A tavern opens. For an evening the loudest news is a bad song, and Rowan calls that progress.

Complete the MineColonies build tavern advancement. Colony growth can continue beyond this optional story.

quests.title: A Gentler Tool
quests.story:
Sera asks you to stop breaking every old thing you find. Some truths need a brush rather than a pickaxe.

Acquire a brush and 16 torches. Search suspicious blocks using the normal archaeology mechanics.

quests.title: A Vessel without a King
quests.story:
An ordinary pot survives where royal proclamations did not. Sera thinks the pot tells the more useful story.

Acquire a decorated pot. A brick-crafted pot counts; rare sherd collection is your own optional pursuit.

quests.title: The Quiet Reading Room
quests.story:
A restored archive needs room for more than royal victories. Leave a shelf for recipes, songs, and complaints.

Donate 8 books and 12 paper for the public reading room.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: A Second Way Home
quests.story:
Iona remembers every expedition that lost its route back. A waystone could make that list shorter.

Acquire a Waystones waystone. Placing and activating your network remains normal mod gameplay.

quests.title: The Museum of Small Things
quests.story:
Sera declines a statue of the king. She requests a room of things people actually used, and a door anyone can open.

Gather 8 item frames, 2 lecterns, and a painting for a museum. The quest checks the supplies; design and build the display in your own style.

quests.title: A Different Kind of Hunter
quests.story:
Ysolde admits that not every dragon is an enemy. "Learn which world you are looking at before you loose an arrow."

Acquire the Saints Dragons draconic codex. This fellowship follows Saints Dragons mechanics, separate from Ice and Fire hunts.

quests.title: Seen beneath the Wings
quests.story:
For once the expedition's purpose is simply to meet something magnificent and leave it alive.

Earn Saints Dragons' encounter_dragon advancement. Consult the codex for habitats and behavior.

quests.title: A Small Beginning
quests.story:
Rowan worries that a dragon cannot possibly fit in Dawnstead. Ysolde suggests starting with an egg and a better plan.

Earn Saints Dragons' hatch_cindervane advancement. Follow the codex's actual egg and hatching requirements.

quests.title: Trust Is Not a Trophy
quests.story:
Ysolde asks you to record the difference between defeating a creature and earning its trust. The blank page is harder than a hunting ledger.

Earn Saints Dragons' tame_cindervane advancement. This is a taming objective, not a kill.

quests.title: The Tide Has a Friend
quests.story:
A Volitans shadows a relief ship all the way to harbor. For the first time the sailors greet a silhouette in the waves with cheers.

Earn Saints Dragons' tame_volitans advancement. This late fellowship goal can be finished whenever you are ready.

quests.title: Supper from the Sea
quests.story:
Boatkeeper Fen promises a route around the raider roads, provided someone feeds his exhausted crew.

Donate 12 cooked cod. Fishing is one source; any legitimate supply counts.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: What the Tide Brings Back
quests.story:
The drowned are gathering beside the moorings. Fen refuses to lose another passenger before the voyage even begins.

Defeat 12 drowned total. Scout the shoreline and deal with trident carriers before entering deep water.

quests.title: A Harbor under the Harbor
quests.story:
Fen's grandmother spoke of a beacon that works beneath the sea. Its fragments still wash ashore after storms.

Gather 8 nautilus shells and one Heart of the Sea. Keep them to make a conduit.

quests.title: The Keeper of the Drowned Vault
quests.story:
The old monument blocks every safe approach to the southern trade route. Its guardian has no concept of a peace treaty.

Defeat one elder guardian. Bring underwater survival equipment and a plan for Mining Fatigue.

quests.title: A Light below the Waves
quests.story:
Fen draws up a new chart with a harbor no storm can extinguish. He marks it with your name, then agrees to use Dawnstead instead.

Acquire a conduit. Build its underwater frame when ready; the objective checks the conduit item, not frame placement.

quests.title: The Hunger beneath the Leaves
quests.story:
Iona has found a trail where every footprint ends beside an innocent-looking plant. She no longer trusts innocent-looking plants.

Defeat 3 Mowzie's Mobs foliaaths.

quests.title: Stone under the Bridge
quests.story:
A troll has made the northern bridge its winter larder. The caravans will not risk the river crossing until it is gone.

Defeat one Ice and Fire troll. Search its underground habitats and give yourself room to avoid its heavy attacks.

quests.title: The White Silence
quests.story:
A Frostmaw sleeps across the mountain pass. The merchants have begun calculating the cost of abandoning the north entirely.

Defeat Mowzie's Mobs' Frostmaw. Treat this as a boss expedition and prepare for cold and heavy damage.

quests.title: The Forest That Would Not Heal
quests.story:
Ysolde warns that the hydra turns every reckless blow into another mouth. Learn its behavior before making the forest worse.

Defeat an Ice and Fire hydra. Research its regeneration mechanics through the mod's guide before fighting.

quests.title: A Road through the Storm
quests.story:
The final route lies beneath a lightning dragon's territory. Iona has promised its reopening; you have promised she will live to see it.

Defeat one Ice and Fire lightning dragon. This hunt is separate from the main story's fire dragon.

quests.title: A Different Uniform
quests.section: The Border Compact | War and Relief
quests.story:
Elian recognizes the raiders' marching drill. Some served under his own officers before the collapse. Recognition does not make their victims safer.

Defeat 8 Takes a Pillage legioners.

quests.title: A Meal before the Treaty
quests.section: The Border Compact | War and Relief
quests.story:
Two villages agree to meet only if neither must bring the food. Rowan volunteers Dawnstead's granary before checking how much is left.

Donate 24 bread and 16 baked potatoes for the negotiations.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Wizard behind the Levy
quests.section: The Border Compact | War and Relief
quests.story:
An evoker has been selling both sides protection from a war he helped arrange. Elian asks you to cancel the arrangement.

Defeat 2 evokers total. Woodland mansions and raids are possible sources; plan for their summoned attackers.

quests.title: The Last Warband
quests.section: The Border Compact | War and Relief
quests.story:
With the paymaster gone, the remaining legioners turn to plunder. The compact will mean nothing if its first travelers cannot cross the border.

Reach 20 Takes a Pillage legioner kills total; earlier kills count.

quests.title: A Border Drawn in Bridges
quests.section: The Border Compact | War and Relief
quests.story:
The villages ask for a wall. Rowan proposes two bridges and a shared storehouse. Elian supports the plan before anyone can ask for his tactical opinion.

Donate 32 oak logs and 32 stone bricks to the reconstruction fund. Build a bridge as an optional personal memorial to the compact.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: Apprentice of the Common Forge
quests.section: Mara | The Work of Many Hands
quests.story:
Mara opens her workshop to apprentices from every village. Her first rule is that learning to mend a plough matters as much as forging a sword.

Donate 24 iron ingots and 16 coal for the apprentice forge. This begins a six-quest optional craft fellowship.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Mara, discuss the apprentice's supplies with Jorge. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the apprentice's supplies with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: Separate materials and training costs. The apprentice should know what is purchased and what the workshop promises to teach.

quests.title: The Heat You Can Measure
quests.section: Mara | The Work of Many Hands
quests.story:
An apprentice wants to heat the furnace until the metal glows white. Mara asks for instruments before enthusiasm burns down the workshop.

Acquire a blast furnace, a smithing table, and a grindstone. Build your own workshop with the retained equipment.

quests.title: Metal without a Coat of Arms
quests.section: Mara | The Work of Many Hands
quests.story:
A border village sends broken royal armor. Mara accepts the metal and refuses the crest stamped into it.

Donate 16 copper ingots and 8 gold ingots for civilian alloy experiments. These commissions do not add new recipes.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Mara, discuss the unmarked metal with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the unmarked metal with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Public stock needs a public account. Record where it goes so nobody can later claim it was a private gift.

quests.title: A Pattern That Survived the Fire
quests.section: Mara | The Work of Many Hands
quests.story:
Mara finds a smithing template in a recovered catalogue. For once the old kingdom left a technique worth preserving.

Acquire a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template. Search bastion treasure or use a legitimate duplication recipe after finding one.

quests.title: The Weight of a Promise
quests.section: Mara | The Work of Many Hands
quests.story:
The apprentices make their first serious protective equipment. Mara asks you to test the workmanship, then reminds you that wearing armor does not excuse starting fights.

Acquire netherite leggings and a netherite helmet. This is an optional high-investment crafting milestone.

quests.title: Master of an Open Workshop
quests.section: Mara | The Work of Many Hands
quests.story:
Mara removes MASTER SMITH from her own door. The workshop now has several people who can answer when a village needs help.

Donate 16 iron ingots and 8 leather to fund the next apprentices. Your Master of the Common Forge title is narrative recognition, not a hidden stat bonus.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Mara, discuss the open workshop with Elian. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the open workshop with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The watch will use the same repair queue. An open workshop should not become a barracks annex whenever I arrive.

quests.title: Books the King Would Not Shelve
quests.story:
The open college receives a cart of censored manuscripts. Sera refuses to decide which should be burned before she has read them.

Acquire 4 rare ink and 32 arcane essence from Iron's Spellbooks. Check JEI for your installed upgrading and crafting routes.

Before returning to Sera, discuss the unapproved books with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the unapproved books with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Preserve the questions rulers disliked where readers can find them. Add context rather than a newly forbidden shelf.

quests.title: A Reading Room after Midnight
quests.story:
Some students can only attend after working the fields. The college needs lamps more urgently than another ceremonial archway.

Donate 12 lanterns and 16 paper for evening classes.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Price of a Better Binding
quests.story:
An apprentice fills a basic spellbook and apologizes for needing another. Sera calls that an excellent problem.

Acquire Iron's Spellbooks' diamond spell book. You retain it for your chosen spell loadout.

Before returning to Sera, discuss the stronger binding with Mara. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the stronger binding with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Reinforce the spine but let the book open flat. A binding should survive use, not discourage it.

quests.title: A Lecturer with an Army
quests.story:
