An archevoker sends the library a demand for its unlicensed students. Sera replies with a reading list; Elian prepares for the less scholarly response.

Defeat one Iron's Spellbooks archevoker. Explore its associated hostile structures and encounters.

quests.title: The Manuscript with No Author
quests.story:
A recovered text seems to describe events that have not happened. Sera insists on cataloguing it without declaring it prophecy.

Acquire an Eldritch Manuscript from Iron's Spellbooks. Use the installed mod's acquisition route; this optional research can wait for late exploration.

quests.title: Keeper of Questions
quests.story:
The library's new oath promises no final answer. It promises that nobody will be punished merely for asking the next question.

Donate 12 books and 8 amethyst shards to endow independent research. The Keeper title records your fellowship completion.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Sera, discuss the keeper's questions with Iona. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the keeper's questions with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Keep a route from conclusions to evidence. Readers should see where another road was possible.

quests.title: The First Harvest Account
quests.section: Rowan | A Province Worth Living In
quests.story:
Rowan discovers that a town can survive a heroic siege and still fail because nobody planned next month's meals.

Earn MineColonies' build farmer advancement. This checks actual colony development rather than possession of a hut block.

Before returning to Rowan, discuss the harvest account with Tamsin. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the harvest account with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Keep household need and seed visible before counting surplus. A full store matters little if next year's planting is called spare.

quests.title: Timber without a Crisis
quests.section: Rowan | A Province Worth Living In
quests.story:
The builders have used the emergency firewood twice. Mara suggests giving timber its own workforce before winter makes the point for her.

Earn MineColonies' build lumberjack advancement.

quests.title: A Place for What Arrives
quests.section: Rowan | A Province Worth Living In
quests.story:
The new trade routes produce a wonderful problem: supplies arrive faster than anyone can find them.

Earn MineColonies' build warehouse advancement. Develop the colony's normal logistics alongside it.

Before returning to Rowan, discuss the arriving supplies with Fen. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the arriving supplies with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Give crates a place and dated receipt. Someone should find them without first finding the steward.

quests.title: Twenty-Five Different Tomorrows
quests.section: Rowan | A Province Worth Living In
quests.story:
At the council table Rowan reads the residents' occupations aloud. For the first time, SOLDIER is not the largest category.

Reach the MineColonies colony population 25 advancement. Growth, housing, and happiness follow that mod's actual systems.

quests.title: The Town Learns to Read
quests.section: Rowan | A Province Worth Living In
quests.story:
Sera sends copies of the recovered histories and asks for a room where people can disagree about them comfortably.

Earn MineColonies' build library advancement.

quests.title: Steward of an Ordinary Place
quests.section: Rowan | A Province Worth Living In
quests.story:
Rowan refuses a statue and asks for a roof that does not leak. A fifth-level town hall is less poetic, but much more useful.

Earn MineColonies' build town hall level 5 advancement. This is a substantial optional long-term settlement goal, not a main-story prerequisite.

Before returning to Rowan, discuss the ordinary stewardship record with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the ordinary stewardship record with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Record routine repairs and answered complaints. The absence of crisis can hide the work that prevented it.

quests.title: A Blank Map Is an Invitation
quests.section: Iona | The Atlas of Safe Returns
quests.story:
Iona opens a fresh atlas with no royal borders printed in it. For now, the rivers are allowed to go wherever they actually go.

Acquire 8 maps and a cartography table. Expand or fill them during your journeys; the objective checks supplies.

Before returning to Iona, discuss the blank atlas with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the blank atlas with Sera
objectives.dialogue: A blank page means its compiler lacks an account. It does not mean nobody lives there.

quests.title: A Camp Above the Clouds
quests.section: Iona | The Atlas of Safe Returns
quests.story:
The mountain route needs a station that tells travelers when to turn back. Iona calls that useful knowledge, even if it disappoints heroes.

Earn Light as a Rabbit by walking on powder snow in leather boots. Follow the vanilla advancement conditions.

objectives.label: Advancement: Adventure / Walk On Powder Snow With Leather Boots

quests.title: An Ocean Does Not End a Road
quests.section: Iona | The Atlas of Safe Returns
quests.story:
Fen offers to teach Iona navigation. She agrees as long as he stops calling the coastline obvious.

Acquire a recovery compass and a spyglass. The recovery compass needs echo shards; this optional milestone encourages careful ancient-city exploration.

Before returning to Iona, discuss the ocean route with Fen. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the ocean route with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Mark landings and conditions for turning back. A useful voyage includes a return plan.

quests.title: The City That Hears You
quests.section: Iona | The Atlas of Safe Returns
quests.story:
Sera asks for observations rather than trophies from the deep ruins. Iona quietly approves of an expedition whose best result is avoiding a fight.

Earn Sneak 100 by sneaking near a sculk sensor or Warden under the vanilla conditions. Killing a Warden is not required.

quests.title: The Shape of the Living World
quests.section: Iona | The Atlas of Safe Returns
quests.story:
The atlas has more names for forests than any royal map. Iona keeps them all; people navigate by differences, not by uniformity.

Earn Adventuring Time. This optional completionist expedition uses Minecraft's biome advancement requirements and can take many journeys.

quests.title: Pathfinder of the Free Roads
quests.section: Iona | The Atlas of Safe Returns
quests.story:
Iona gives the finished atlas to the youngest scout and keeps the rough field notes. A useful map is one somebody else can use.

Donate 16 paper, 4 compasses, and 8 leather to print public travel guides.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Iona, discuss the free-road atlas with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the free-road atlas with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Copies remain available without travel permits. Information about public roads should help people use them.

quests.title: The Shipwright's First Argument
quests.story:
Fen wants a fast ship. The carpenter wants a repairable one. Rowan asks which can bring more people home and ends the argument.

Donate 48 oak logs and 24 iron ingots to the common fleet fund. This is a supply quest; it does not spawn a ship.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Fen, discuss the shipwright's proposal with Mara. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the shipwright's proposal with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Inspect the frame before choosing the finish. A boat succeeds by bringing people home, not by looking complete at launch.

quests.title: The Harbor Apothecary
quests.story:
Tamsin demands a stocked infirmary on every relief vessel. Fen discovers that being captain includes learning where bandages are kept.

Acquire 8 honey bottles and 8 golden carrots for your own shipboard kit.

quests.title: The Light in the Current
quests.story:
A second underwater landmark would let damaged vessels approach the harbor without relying on a single light.

Acquire 16 sea lanterns for a harbor approach. Build the lighted route in your chosen waters; placement is not tracked.

Before returning to Fen, discuss the light in the current with Iona. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the light in the current with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Test from the difficult approach. The traveler who most needs a beacon should be able to see it.

quests.title: The Reef That Became a Trap
quests.story:
A Coralssus has made the planned approach unsafe. Fen waits for a clear route rather than gambling another crew on speed.

Defeat one Cataclysm Coralssus. Check the sea ruins and prepare for the surrounding defenders.

quests.title: Letters across the Water
quests.story:
The first passenger service carries more letters than cargo. Rowan considers that a sign of recovery rather than poor business.

Donate 24 paper and 12 ink sacs to the free coastal post.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: Harbormaster of the Open Coast
quests.story:
Fen names no flagship. Every captain receives the same charter: carry people who need passage, and come back with the whole crew.

Acquire a bell and 8 lanterns for the public pier. Your Harbormaster title marks the completed fleet story.

Before returning to Fen, discuss the open-coast rules with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the open-coast rules with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Publish fees and appeal rights. An open coast cannot hide a different private demand at every landing.

quests.title: Medicine Begins in the Soil
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden after the War
quests.story:
Tamsin inventories the herbs and discovers that the dispensary depends on three exhausted foragers. She asks for a garden instead of another expedition.

Acquire a composter, a beehive, and 16 wheat seeds. Plant a working garden in your own design; the quest checks supplies.

Before returning to Tamsin, discuss the common garden soil with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the common garden soil with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The garden has a clear land agreement. Its keeper should not learn at harvest that the plot was promised elsewhere.

quests.title: A Crop Nobody Can Eat Alone
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden after the War
quests.story:
Rowan suggests storing seed separately from supper. Tamsin labels the seed chest more aggressively than any poison bottle.

Donate 32 wheat seeds, 16 carrots, and 16 potatoes to the public seed reserve.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Healer Tests Her Own Advice
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden after the War
quests.story:
A new draught claims to make heavy work easier. Tamsin refuses to prescribe anything the dispensary has not tested honestly.

Gain the Strength and Swiftness effects through legitimate sources. The effects are separate tracked milestones; they need not be simultaneous.

Before returning to Tamsin, discuss the healer's trial notes with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the healer's trial notes with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Keep observations and limits together. One personal account cannot promise the same outcome for everyone.

quests.title: The Pharmacist's Missing Labels
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden after the War
quests.story:
An illager alchemist has been selling deliberately mislabeled medicine along the border. Tamsin is angrier about the fraud than the price.

Defeat 2 Illager Invasion alchemists. The exact registered entity is illagerinvasion:alchemist.

quests.title: The Table with Room for Everyone
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden after the War
quests.story:
The garden produces a feast with ingredients nobody in Dawnstead once thought they would taste again.

Earn A Balanced Diet. This optional long-term food collection follows vanilla advancement requirements; it is never required for the campaign ending.

quests.title: Physician of the Common Garden
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden after the War
quests.story:
Tamsin trains two assistants and takes her first afternoon off. Rowan has to remind her twice that rest is part of the treatment.

Donate 16 honey bottles and 16 glass bottles to complete the dispensary endowment.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Tamsin, discuss the garden handover with Elian. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the garden handover with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The watch has contact details and clear paths. Tamsin can close without becoming permanently on call.

quests.title: An Egg with a Future
quests.story:
Ysolde brings an account of a Raevyx clutch and asks you to read every page before approaching it. Wonder is not a substitute for care.

Earn Saints Dragons' acquire_raevyx_egg advancement. Follow the draconic codex's actual acquisition instructions.

Before returning to Ysolde, discuss the egg's care plan with Tamsin. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the egg's care plan with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Plan food, space, and rest before celebrating. A future life needs preparation more than an impressive promise.

quests.title: The Storm in the Cradle
quests.story:
Mara agrees to help prepare the hatching grounds, provided Ysolde handles every question involving lightning.

Earn Saints Dragons' hatch_raevyx advancement. The codex describes the environmental and hatching requirements.

quests.title: A Patient Shore
quests.story:
Fen has found an account of Stegonaut hatchlings near the coast. This time he asks for a nursery plan before naming one.

Earn Saints Dragons' hatch_stegonaut advancement. This can be pursued while raising your Raevyx.

Before returning to Ysolde, discuss the patient shoreline with Fen. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the patient shoreline with Fen
objectives.dialogue: We will keep this stretch quiet and redirect boats. Patience is easier when the harbor makes room for it.

quests.title: Trust beneath Thunder
quests.story:
Ysolde waits outside the enclosure and lets you decide when to approach. Earning trust cannot be rushed by a quest title.

Earn Saints Dragons' tame_raevyx advancement. This is a genuine taming milestone, not a kill or inventory proxy.

quests.title: The Long Back of the Tide
quests.story:
The Stegonaut recognizes the sound of the harbor bell. Fen is delighted until it expects him to provide breakfast.

Earn Saints Dragons' tame_stegonaut advancement.

quests.title: Warden of the Living Sky
quests.story:
Ysolde closes her oldest hunting ledger and begins a husbandry journal. The first entry records the day she stopped thinking of every wing as a threat.

Earn Saints Dragons' tame_varasuchus advancement. Raise and care for the creature through the codex's normal progression; your fellowship is now complete.

Before returning to Ysolde, discuss the living-sky routes with Iona. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the living-sky routes with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Mark nests and clear approaches. Maps can support respectful distance instead of turning every discovery into a destination.

quests.title: The Watch Writes Its Own Rules
quests.section: Elian | The Watch without a Throne
quests.story:
Elian asks each recruit to name an order they would refuse. It is the strangest drill the former soldiers have ever attended.

Donate 8 books and 16 paper for the watch charter and training manuals.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

Before returning to Elian, discuss the watch's own rules with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the watch's own rules with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Give people outside the watch a complaint route. Authority cannot be its own only witness.

quests.title: A Quartermaster's Definition of Courage
quests.section: Elian | The Watch without a Throne
quests.story:
The quartermaster refuses to issue heroic speeches in place of spare equipment. Elian backs her immediately.

Donate 4 shields and 32 arrows for trainee equipment.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: The Colors Come Down
quests.section: Elian | The Watch without a Throne
quests.story:
A sorcerer is recruiting villages under the old sun banner. The watch cannot let fear restore the kingdom you already broke.

Defeat 2 Illager Invasion sorcerers during your border expeditions.

Before returning to Elian, discuss the lowered colors with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the lowered colors with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Preserve the banners with an honest account. Recording their history differs from asking people to march behind them.

quests.title: A Spell That Claims a Province
quests.section: Elian | The Watch without a Throne
quests.story:
An invoker has declared a private kingdom by magical decree. Sera reads it and finds no provision for the inhabitants to disagree.

Defeat one Illager Invasion invoker. Prepare for the full encounter rather than treating it as an ordinary illager.

quests.title: A Watchtower Is Also a Shelter
quests.section: Elian | The Watch without a Throne
quests.story:
Rowan asks that every watch post keep blankets for travelers. Elian adds the request to the standing orders instead of calling it charity.

Donate 16 white wool and 16 bread for public shelter stores.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.title: Marshal by Consent
quests.section: Elian | The Watch without a Throne
quests.story:
The watch offers Elian a lifetime commission. He declines and proposes a term that can be renewed, or ended, by the people they protect.

Enter "service can be withdrawn" to sign the watch charter. The title is a story milestone; it does not spawn guards or grant command permissions.

Before returning to Elian, discuss the marshal's equipment with Mara. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.

objectives.label: Discuss the marshal's equipment with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Equipment remains common stock, issued by duty and returned for repair. Keep it that way if the title starts to resemble a crown.

quests.title: The Compass That Remembers
quests.section: The Pale Road | Oaths beyond Death
quests.story:
A traveler leaves a compass that points toward unfinished battles. Sera asks whether a promise can survive long enough to become a prison.

Acquire Soulslike Weaponry's Boss Compass. Consult its tooltip and installed guide for the encounters it locates.

quests.title: The Knight Still on Duty
quests.section: The Pale Road | Oaths beyond Death
quests.story:
A Returning Knight guards a charge whose name has been lost. Elian asks you to give it the one order no monarch bothered to send: rest.

Defeat Soulslike Weaponry's Returning Knight. The legacy legendary quest may share credit for this exact target.

quests.title: Provision a Road with No Inns
quests.section: The Pale Road | Oaths beyond Death
quests.story:
Tamsin cannot accompany you into every tomb. She can make sure you stop treating an empty food pouch as a brave choice.

Acquire 16 golden carrots and 8 honey bottles before the deeper expeditions.

quests.title: The King beneath the Cairn
quests.section: The Pale Road | Oaths beyond Death
quests.story:
A Draugr still guards the border of a realm that survives only in grave goods. Sera records its name so victory does not erase it a second time.

Defeat Soulslike Weaponry's Draugr boss, soulsweapons:draugr_boss. Use the installed boss guide for location and activation.

quests.title: The Moon Has No Subjects
quests.section: The Pale Road | Oaths beyond Death
quests.story:
The Moonknight's oath names the sky itself as sovereign. Ysolde wonders whether the sky ever agreed to accept its service.

Complete the Soulslike Weaponry Moonknight encounter and receive kill credit for soulsweapons:moonknight. Prepare for its full encounter phases.

quests.title: A Promise Allowed to End
quests.section: The Pale Road | Oaths beyond Death
quests.story:
Sera adds one final line to the covenant archive: a good oath must contain a way to be released. Elian reads it longer than anyone else.

Donate 8 soul lanterns and 16 paper to build a memorial to the released. This closes the optional Pale Road story.

Turn-in: submitted items are consumed when you claim this quest.

quests.story:
Tamsin has received a report of a mutant zombie that keeps rising after its apparent defeat. She asks for certainty before she reopens the cemetery road.

Defeat a Mutant Monsters mutant zombie completely, including its revival mechanics.

quests.title: The Thunder in the Quarry
quests.story:
Mara evacuates the quarry after a green silhouette appears above the blasting face. Nobody is paid enough to test whether it is an ordinary creeper.

Defeat a Mutant Monsters mutant creeper in an area where explosions will not destroy your home.

quests.title: A Shadow with Too Many Hands
quests.story:
Iona has been followed through three camps by the same impossible silhouette. This hunt requires more preparation than a traveler's campfire.

Defeat a Mutant Monsters mutant enderman. Learn its full encounter and take healing and an escape plan.

quests.title: Do Not Meet Her Eyes
quests.story:
Ysolde crosses out an entire page of brave advice and replaces it with one practical warning about the gorgon's gaze.

Defeat an Ice and Fire gorgon. Consult the Bestiary and prepare its specific countermeasures before entering the temple.

quests.title: The Bronze Sky
quests.story:
A flock of Stymphalian birds has closed the ridge road. Elian asks for precision; farmers are sheltering beneath those trees.

Defeat 8 Ice and Fire Stymphalian birds total. Their exact target is iceandfire:stymphalian_bird.

quests.title: The Sun Court
quests.story:
The scouts report a powerful guardian beneath an unfamiliar sun emblem. Sera asks you to learn the encounter rather than assuming every crowned figure fights alike.

Defeat Mowzie's Mobs' Umvuthi. Prepare for the encounter mechanics and surrounding followers.

quests.title: A Wager Nobody Else Pays
quests.story:
Dame Fortuna's invitation promises a shortcut to prosperity. Rowan asks that any wager you make be paid from your own purse.

Acquire the Devil's Ante through JEI and use Meet Your Fight's normal summoning method, then defeat Dame Fortuna.

quests.title: The Storm beyond the Charter
quests.story:
The finished council receives its first ordinary request: ships need help beyond the charted coast. There will always be work worth doing after the ending.

Use Cataclysm's Storm Eye to seek the Acropolis and defeat Scylla through the installed encounter mechanics.

quests.title: A Horizon with No Fence
quests.section: Eight Arts of the Long Journey
quests.story:
Iona has never believed a map should end at the edge of a page. She asks you to bring back a view no road can offer.

Find and acquire Elytra to earn Sky's the Limit. Locate an End ship; it is deliberately optional to the main story.

quests.title: The Distance between Two Breaths
quests.section: Eight Arts of the Long Journey
quests.story:
Elian asks his finest archers to learn patience before power. A long shot is a lesson in waiting for the right moment.

Earn Sniper Duel using the vanilla skeleton-distance and projectile conditions.

quests.title: One Shot, Two Lessons
quests.section: Eight Arts of the Long Journey
quests.story:
The quartermaster would prefer that every training exercise used fewer arrows. Iona takes the suggestion more seriously than intended.

Earn Two Birds, One Arrow through the vanilla Piercing crossbow and phantom conditions.

objectives.label: Advancement: Adventure / Two Birds One Arrow

quests.title: An Unlikely Homecoming
quests.section: Eight Arts of the Long Journey
quests.story:
Fen wagers that every lost traveler wants to go home. Sera points out that a ghast may have a very different understanding of home.

Earn Uneasy Alliance by bringing a ghast to the Overworld and killing it there under vanilla conditions. This difficult expedition is entirely optional.

quests.title: The Patient Keeper
quests.section: Eight Arts of the Long Journey
quests.story:
Ysolde's sanctuary proposal contains more feed budgets than heroic illustrations. She says that is how you know it is sincere.

Earn Two by Two by breeding the animals required by the vanilla advancement. Modded species are not automatically added to that requirement.

quests.title: The Apothecary's Full Shelf
quests.section: Eight Arts of the Long Journey
quests.story:
Tamsin wants one carefully supervised demonstration of the dispensary's complete brewing repertoire. She has already prepared a bed afterward.

Earn A Furious Cocktail by satisfying the vanilla simultaneous potion-effect requirements. This is an optional advanced brewing challenge.

quests.title: The Bestiary Written in Scars
quests.section: Eight Arts of the Long Journey
quests.story:
Elian asks you to annotate the old monster manual with what actually worked. A warning can save a life more reliably than a trophy.

Earn Monsters Hunted by defeating the entities required by the vanilla advancement. This does not mean killing every entity in the supplied registry list.

quests.title: The Strangest Relief Wagon
quests.section: Eight Arts of the Long Journey
quests.story:
Fen insists that a strider counts as a practical transport proposal. Mara agrees to build the loading ramp on the condition that somebody else tests it.

Earn Feels Like Home with the vanilla Overworld strider-riding distance requirement. Build a controlled lava route away from settlements.

objectives.label: Advancement: Nether / Ride Strider In Overworld Lava

quests.title: The Machine under the Orchard
quests.story:
Mara receives reports of a buried engine that still obeys war orders nobody remembers issuing.

Use Cataclysm's Mech Eye to seek the Ancient Factory and check the Harbinger's activation requirements before entering. Defeat the named boss once; tracked earlier kills may count.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.

quests.title: The Mountain's White Crown
quests.story:

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.

quests.title: The Returning Knight

Defeat Soulslike Weaponry's Returning Knight. Consult the installed mod's guide or JEI for its encounter and summoning items. Defeat the named boss once; tracked earlier kills may count.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.

Ysolde returns her hunting spear to the rack. The oldest dragon in her notes is now a creature she hopes you will meet as a friend.

Earn Saints Dragons' tame_ignivorus advancement. Consult the draconic codex for its complete taming path; killing an Ignivorus does not complete this quest.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.

quests.title: A Letter with Your Handwriting
quests.section: XV | The Signal beneath the Bells
quests.story:
The new council receives a letter describing a disaster that has not happened. It is written in your hand. Rowan refuses to burn it; Sera refuses to believe it. Both ask you to keep the original.

Hold a writable book and an echo shard. Echo shards can be found in ancient-city chests; you keep the evidence.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the impossible letter with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.
quests.aftermath: Under lamplight, a second sentence becomes visible: do not let the bells agree.

objectives.label: Discuss the impossible letter with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The handwriting resembles yours. That is evidence about the letter, not proof of its account. Compare paper and events separately.

quests.title: The Listeners at the Window
quests.section: XV | The Signal beneath the Bells
quests.story:
Every bell in Dawnstead sounds a fraction late. Sera thinks an old signal network is answering the village instead of echoing it.

Craft two note blocks. Crafting is recorded from installation onward, including output quantity.
quests.aftermath: The two notes produce three answers. Something is learning the interval.

quests.title: A Refuge for the Sleepless
quests.section: XV | The Signal beneath the Bells
quests.story:
Tamsin treats people who have dreamed the same empty street. A crowded hall frightens them more than a locked door, so she asks for rooms with separate lamps.

Donate 16 white wool and 8 lanterns. This branch can be completed before or after the listening experiment.
quests.aftermath: For the first time in a week, the hall sleeps. One patient leaves a drawing of a city beneath the roots.

quests.title: The City That Answers
quests.section: XV | The Signal beneath the Bells
quests.story:
The letter describes a place where silence is engineered. Sera marks the deep dark on your map, but refuses to send a novice alone.

Enter a deep dark biome. Discovery remains recorded after you leave; defeating a warden is not required.
quests.aftermath: Your footsteps return as the sound of a crowd. The city remembers people, not merely noise.

quests.title: A Frequency in Stone
quests.section: XV | The Signal beneath the Bells
quests.story:
Mara recognizes the rhythm as a forge signal used before the king was born. The machinery was built to warn the provinces together. Someone has changed what a warning means.

Hold a calibrated sculk sensor and 8 amethyst shards.
quests.aftermath: The sensor reveals an instruction hidden beneath the alarm: assemble and surrender judgment.

quests.title: Publish the Impossible
quests.section: XV | The Signal beneath the Bells
quests.story:
Rowan wants to tell the council at once. Elian fears panic; Sera fears the habit of secrecy more. They agree the evidence must survive either decision.

Write "a warning is not an order", then choose how the first report is delivered.
quests.aftermath: The warning travels under your seal. The investigation belongs to the provinces now.

objectives.label: Write: a warning is not an order

choices.title: Open council hearing
choices.result: Rowan reads the report in the square. Frightened citizens begin sending their own accounts; the archive fills with witnesses.

choices.title: Send local witnesses
choices.result: Elian escorts witnesses to each settlement. Rumor moves faster, but every explanation arrives with a person who can answer questions.

quests.title: An Account That Never Closes
quests.section: XVI | The People in the Machine
quests.story:
Sera names the buried network the Hollow Concord. It once balanced food between provinces; its oldest accounts list names beside quantities of heat.

Hold 16 paper and a recovery compass.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the account that never closes with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.
quests.aftermath: The compass turns toward the archive. Its needle cannot distinguish a lost person from a stored memory.

objectives.label: Discuss the account that never closes with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: An account demanding a final balance from living people can always invent another debt. Find the rule that lets someone leave.

quests.title: Meals outside the Ledger
quests.section: XVI | The People in the Machine
quests.story:
Tamsin notices that the signal weakens wherever people share food without recording a debt. The machine cannot price a gift it never sees.

Donate 32 bread and 16 pumpkin pies.
quests.aftermath: The kitchen tears up its debt slips. Several names disappear from the machine's newest account.

quests.title: The Witness Who Trades
quests.section: XVI | The People in the Machine
quests.story:
A trader remembers a royal assessor buying bells from every village. He will talk to someone who approaches without a drawn weapon.

Right-click a villager. This records the conversation; ordinary villager trading remains available.
quests.aftermath: He describes an assessor with no shadow. Her assistants called her the Auditor.

quests.title: A Map of Quiet Places
quests.section: XVI | The People in the Machine
quests.story:
Iona suspects the network follows settlements, not borders. She needs a refuge the court never found.

Discover a mushroom fields biome. An ocean expedition may be necessary.
quests.aftermath: The signal vanishes among the mushrooms. Iona adds a safe meeting place to the atlas.

quests.title: Names Are Not Numbers
quests.section: XVI | The People in the Machine
quests.story:
Sera decodes a folio and finds no soldiers, just the names of people the court considered replaceable. Mara recognizes her mother's signature beneath a refusal.

Donate 8 books and 16 glow ink sacs to preserve the testimony.
quests.aftermath: Mara asks for a copy without the royal seal. She wants to remember a person, not a case.

quests.title: The Right to Be Missing
quests.section: XVI | The People in the Machine
quests.story:
Rowan writes the first law the Concord cannot understand: no person owes the state an account of every moment of their life.

Write "no life belongs to a ledger".
quests.aftermath: Across the provinces, blank pages are bound into the public registers. The Auditor sends her first reply: correction pending.

objectives.target: no life belongs to a ledger
objectives.label: Write: no life belongs to a ledger

quests.title: Mara Opens the Old Chest
quests.section: XVII | A Bell with No Master
quests.story:
Mara has kept the tools her mother used to build the first signal relay. She offers them without asking to lead the expedition. "Let me finish the part she refused to finish."

Hold an anvil and 16 copper ingots.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the old workshop chest with Mara. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.
quests.aftermath: Inside the tool roll is a drawing of a bell that listens before it rings.

objectives.label: Discuss the old workshop chest with Mara
objectives.dialogue: These tools served work I no longer choose. Examining them does not excuse the decisions made with them.

quests.title: Copper for the Listening Ring
quests.section: XVII | A Bell with No Master
quests.story:
A royal relay speaks in a single voice. Mara wants many imperfect pieces, joined where anyone can see the seams.

Smelt 24 copper ingots and take them from a furnace or blast furnace. Hopper extraction does not count.
quests.aftermath: The seams remain visible. Mara refuses to polish them away.

quests.title: Hands beyond the Forge
quests.section: XVII | A Bell with No Master
quests.story:
The workshop cannot keep its workers alive on philosophy. Tamsin asks for food before another night of experiments.

Donate 24 baked potatoes and 8 honey bottles.
quests.aftermath: The apprentices bring their families to supper. Someone starts singing off-key; the relay fails to predict it.

quests.title: A Circuit That Can Say No
quests.section: XVII | A Bell with No Master
quests.story:
Sera designs a delay that allows a settlement to reject a command. Mara insists the switch must be within reach of the smallest apprentice.

Craft 8 repeaters and 4 comparators.
quests.aftermath: The test signal arrives, waits, and dies unanswered. Everyone in the workshop cheers.

quests.title: The Last Royal Standard
quests.section: XVII | A Bell with No Master
quests.story:
Elian brings an intact royal signal head. Its frame is valuable, but Mara will not let its ownership mark survive in the new apparatus.

Donate 4 gold ingots and 16 iron ingots to recast the fittings.
quests.aftermath: The crown melts into a hinge. Nothing breaks when the king's name disappears.

quests.title: The Uncommanded Bell
quests.section: XVII | A Bell with No Master
quests.story:
The prototype can either warn every settlement immediately or wait for a second witness. Both choices carry a cost; Mara asks you to name it in the record.

Hold a bell and choose the relay protocol. The journal records your decision; it does not alter placed bell blocks.
quests.aftermath: The new bell leaves the workshop wrapped in an ordinary blanket.

choices.title: Warn at the first sign
choices.result: Warnings travel quickly, with uncertainty stated aloud. Elian trains the watch to investigate before acting.

choices.title: Require two witnesses
choices.result: The provinces accept a slower alarm in exchange for corroboration. Iona recruits couriers so isolated villages are never left waiting.

quests.title: Where the Couriers Disappear
quests.story:
Iona finds a route marked on no map: messages arrive before their messengers leave. The Hollow Concord has been routing its commands through the Nether.

Enter the Nether after installing Chronicles. A recorded visit remains valid.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the missing couriers with Fen. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.
quests.aftermath: A distant ringing follows you through the portal. The sound stops when you turn to listen.

objectives.label: Discuss the missing couriers with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Record every last confirmed stop. Similar disappearances may share a cause; do not force agreement by omitting differences.

quests.title: A Safe Return Is a Plan
quests.story:
Fen offers boats for the surface leg and insists on spare provisions for anyone who turns back. Nobody earns a place by proving they can suffer.

Donate 32 cooked cod and 16 torches.
quests.aftermath: The first courier chooses to return home. Iona strikes the word deserter from the old route book.

quests.title: Glass for the Lost Horizon
quests.story:
Sera needs lenses that can show a signal crossing the boundary between worlds. Mara asks for clear glass and promises no miraculous weapon.

Smelt 32 glass and retrieve it yourself.
quests.aftermath: Through the lenses the signal resembles handwriting, corrected over and over until no author remains.

quests.title: Under a Sky of Basalt
quests.story:
The oldest relay is buried beneath black volcanic pillars. Iona marks a route that avoids building a road through anyone's home.

Discover a basalt deltas biome.
quests.aftermath: The stone repeats the warning from the first letter, in your voice this time.

quests.title: The Heat of a Thousand Orders
quests.story:
The relay is guarded by the same creatures the court once harvested for power. Elian asks for a clear route while Sera copies the pattern.

Reach 12 lifetime blaze kills and hold 8 obsidian.
quests.aftermath: With the pattern copied, the expedition returns. No one is asked to stay behind to buy time.

quests.title: A Return Address
quests.story:
The message can finally be answered. Iona wants the reply signed by every province, not by a new savior speaking for them.

Write "we answer in our own voices".
quests.aftermath: The Concord answers with coordinates made of names. The Auditor is waiting at the far end of the old road.

objectives.target: we answer in our own voices
objectives.label: Write: we answer in our own voices

quests.title: An Audience without a Throne
quests.section: XIX | The Auditor without a Shadow
quests.story:
The Auditor is a chorus of recorded officials, each correcting the next. It offers perfect peace in exchange for the right to decide what every person needs.

Enter the End. This encounter is told through the journal; no new boss is spawned.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the audience without a throne with Sera. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.
quests.aftermath: Sera realizes the chorus cannot imagine a promise freely kept. It recognizes only instructions and failures.

objectives.label: Discuss the audience without a throne with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Preserve the refusals as well as the answers. A system calling every objection a missing entry cannot hear what we actually said.

quests.title: The Guard Who Chose to Leave
quests.section: XIX | The Auditor without a Shadow
quests.story:
Elian remembers the order that abandoned his regiment. The Auditor calls that decision efficient. He asks you to give the survivors a different account.

Donate 8 shields for the independent watch. Items are consumed only when this reward is claimed.
quests.aftermath: Each shield bears a settlement's mark. None bears a crown.

quests.title: Evidence That Cannot Be Spent
quests.section: XIX | The Auditor without a Shadow
quests.story:
Mara brings her mother's refusal. Tamsin brings patients' letters. Rowan brings the blank pages that terrified the royal clerks.

Hold a written record: 3 writable books and 4 echo shards.
quests.aftermath: The chorus cannot reconcile the testimonies. For the first time, it asks a question without supplying the answer.

quests.title: The Silence between Instructions
quests.section: XIX | The Auditor without a Shadow
quests.story:
Sera proposes leaving a pause in the network, long enough for a listener to choose. The Auditor calls the pause an error.

Craft a daylight detector and 4 redstone lamps.
quests.aftermath: One voice in the chorus falls silent voluntarily. The others cannot order it to resume.

quests.title: A Watch against Certainty
quests.section: XIX | The Auditor without a Shadow
quests.story:
Elian expects the last signal to draw the dead along the old roads. He asks for preparation rather than a final glorious charge.

Reach 40 lifetime skeleton kills and 40 lifetime zombie kills.
quests.aftermath: The watch returns in groups, carrying its wounded. Elian counts the living before asking whether the road is clear.

quests.title: What We Owe the Voices
quests.section: XIX | The Auditor without a Shadow
quests.story:
The Auditor can be preserved as an archive that cannot issue orders, or allowed to fall silent. The witnesses disagree, but they refuse to force unanimity.

Write "memory is not authority", then decide the fate of the chorus.
quests.aftermath: The command channel closes. Whatever remains must ask permission to be heard.

choices.title: Keep a listening archive
choices.result: Sera preserves the voices behind a public switch. Descendants may listen, answer, or walk away; no voice can command them.

choices.title: Let the chorus rest
choices.result: Rowan reads every recoverable name before the relay goes quiet. The testimonies survive in books, with room for disagreement in the margins.

quests.title: No Parade Today
quests.story:
The council has ordered a parade. Rowan cancels it when a farmer asks who will bring in the harvest. For once, the urgent work is ordinary.

Donate 64 wheat and 32 carrots.
quests.aftermath: The banners become tablecloths. Nobody complains about the missing speeches.

quests.title: A School with Open Doors
quests.story:
Sera wants a school where students can correct the books. She asks Mara to make desks strong enough to survive generations of impatient questions.

Craft 8 bookshelves and 2 lecterns.
quests.aftermath: The first lesson begins with a crossed-out sentence from the old royal history.

quests.title: A Harbor without Chains
quests.story:
Fen returns the emergency vessels to their crews. A free harbor needs stores anyone can draw on when weather turns against them.

Donate 32 dried kelp and 16 barrels.
quests.aftermath: The harbor ledger records what was taken, but leaves the debtor column out entirely.

quests.title: The Last Patrol of the War
quests.story:
Elian takes down the wartime watch bill. Tomorrow's patrol will ask travelers whether they need help before asking where they came from.

Right-click a villager and hold a compass.
quests.aftermath: The first traveler asks for directions to the school. Elian walks them there himself.

quests.title: A Light Someone Else Lit
quests.story:
Iona finds a lantern burning at a crossing you have never visited. The road has grown beyond the people who founded it.

Craft 16 lanterns for the next generation of wayfarers.
quests.aftermath: You leave a few lanterns unclaimed in the workshop. Someone else will know where they are needed.

quests.title: The Chronicle Stays Open
quests.story:
Rowan returns the letter from the ashes. Beneath every correction, every refusal and every impossible promise, its first request is still legible: bring a light.

Write "the dawn belongs to everyone" to close Book III. Side stories and relief contracts remain open.

Before returning to Eldara, discuss the open chronicle with Rowan. Complete the earlier objectives before this conversation.
quests.aftermath: THE HOLLOW CONCORD: COMPLETE. No crown changes hands. No voice speaks for everyone. In the square, a bell rings because someone chose to ring it, and a city wakes to a day it is free to shape.

objectives.label: Write: the dawn belongs to everyone
Discuss the open chronicle with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The household work continues. A river district outside our delivery lists has sent a petition. Bring it to Eldara when you are ready for another journey.

quests.title: An Unsigned Hammer
quests.story:
An apprentice leaves a repaired hammer outside Mara's door without a name. She recognizes the careful work of someone taught to expect rejection.

Craft an iron pickaxe.
quests.aftermath: Mara hangs the hammer on the public tool rack instead of keeping it.

quests.title: A Place at the Bench
quests.story:
The workshop has tools but too few work surfaces. Mara wants a bench anyone may use without asking whose child they are.

Donate 32 oak planks and 8 iron ingots.
quests.aftermath: The first apprentice arrives before dawn and leaves the bench cleaner than they found it.

quests.title: Learning the Heat
quests.story:
A novice ruins a batch of iron and tries to repay the loss with their supper money. Mara sends them to eat and asks you for a demonstration.

Smelt 16 iron ingots and retrieve them yourself.
quests.aftermath: The next batch succeeds. Mara records the failed batch as tuition, not debt.

quests.title: The Maker's Mark
quests.story:
The apprentices ask whose mark to stamp on their work. Mara hands each of them a different punch.

Craft a smithing table.
quests.aftermath: For the first time, the workshop sells tools that do not carry Mara's name.

quests.title: The Work That Matters
quests.story:
A noble commissions a ceremonial sword. The same morning, the granary door breaks. Mara asks which job the apprentices should learn from first.

Donate 4 iron doors and 8 iron ingots to the refuge.
quests.aftermath: The grain stays dry. The noble discovers that a sword can wait.

quests.title: A Name beside Her Own
quests.story:
The unsigned apprentice finally signs a piece of work. Mara notices that her own hands no longer shake when she lets someone else finish a job.

Write "no hand works alone".
quests.aftermath: Mara adds a second name above the workshop door, then leaves room for more.

quests.title: The Healer's Empty Cup
quests.section: Tamsin | A Garden for the Living
quests.story:
Tamsin has been giving away her own meals. Rowan asks you to help without turning her kindness into another public obligation.

Donate 8 mushroom stew.
quests.aftermath: Someone leaves a full cup on Tamsin's desk. This time she drinks it.

quests.title: Seeds with No Owner
quests.section: Tamsin | A Garden for the Living
quests.story:
The gardens were once divided by the families who could pay for a fence. Tamsin proposes a shared bed beside the dispensary.

Donate 32 wheat seeds and 8 beetroot seeds.
quests.aftermath: A child plants the first row crooked. Nobody makes them pull it out.

quests.title: A Companion at the Door
quests.section: Tamsin | A Garden for the Living
quests.story:
A stray wolf waits outside the dispensary every night. Tamsin thinks the animal has chosen a person who has not yet learned to accept company.

Tame a wolf after installing Chronicles.
quests.aftermath: The wolf sleeps beneath a waiting-room bench. Patients begin arriving a little less afraid.

quests.title: Bottles for Tomorrow
quests.section: Tamsin | A Garden for the Living
quests.story:
Tamsin wants to train others before the next emergency. The lesson begins with washing equipment, which disappoints the aspiring miracle workers.

Craft 24 glass bottles.
quests.aftermath: By evening the apprentices can prepare a room without waiting for her instructions.

quests.title: Permission to Rest
quests.section: Tamsin | A Garden for the Living
quests.story:
The new healers arrange a day off for Tamsin. She objects until they show her a complete supply cupboard.

Donate 16 honey bottles and 16 apples.
quests.aftermath: Tamsin spends the afternoon in the garden. Nothing terrible happens while she is absent.

quests.title: A Garden Is Not a Monument
quests.section: Tamsin | A Garden for the Living
quests.story:
The council offers to name the garden after Tamsin. She asks for a bench in the shade and enough room for another row of beans.

Write "care is work we share".
quests.aftermath: The sign reads Common Garden. Tamsin sits beneath it with an empty cup and no intention of getting up yet.

objectives.label: Write: care is work we share

quests.title: The Blank Corner
quests.story:
Iona has mapped hundreds of roads but left the valley where she grew up blank. She says there is nothing worth visiting there.

Craft a compass and hold 8 paper.
quests.aftermath: A narrow track appears in the corner of the map, drawn in a different ink.

quests.title: A Pack for Two
quests.story:
Iona agrees to travel if nobody calls the journey a pilgrimage. Fen helps pack supplies without asking what happened in the valley.

Donate 16 bread and 8 leather.
quests.aftermath: The second pack is for anyone you meet who wants to come back with you.

quests.title: The Shape of Home
quests.story:
The first familiar trees stop Iona mid-sentence. She points out landmarks that no military map ever bothered to name.

Discover a meadow biome.
quests.aftermath: The place has changed enough to hurt, and enough to keep living.

quests.title: The People Who Stayed
quests.story:
Iona expected graves. Instead she finds people who remember her and have stories that continued after she left.

Right-click a villager.
quests.aftermath: Someone asks whether she still gets lost on straight roads. She laughs before she remembers to be ashamed.

quests.title: A Road in Both Directions
quests.story:
The valley needs trade, but Iona refuses to make belonging conditional on departure. Supplies will travel both ways.

Donate 16 rails and 8 powered rails.
quests.aftermath: Fen redraws the route with two arrows. Iona insists on keeping both.

quests.title: The Place She Can Return To
quests.story:
Iona fills the blank corner at last. There is no grand revelation in it, just a road, a well, and the names of people she can visit.

Write "leaving is not forgetting".
quests.aftermath: She gives Rowan a copy of the atlas and keeps the version with muddy fingerprints.

quests.title: The Captain's Sealed Report
quests.story:
Elian writes the same report every night and burns it before morning. Mara asks you to give him a reason to finish one.

Hold a writable book and a shield.
quests.aftermath: He writes the names of the abandoned regiment before writing his own rank.

quests.title: An Ordinary Watch
quests.story:
New recruits want stories of heroic charges. Elian assigns them a kitchen watch and asks for practical equipment.

Craft 8 torches and 2 shields.
quests.aftermath: The recruits learn that keeping someone safe usually means noticing what they need.

quests.title: The Families at the Gate
quests.story:
The missing soldiers' families arrive for answers. Rowan refuses to make them wait until the captain is ready to speak.

Donate 16 bread and 16 white wool.
quests.aftermath: Elian meets them without armor. Some listen; some leave. He does not ask for forgiveness.

quests.title: A Patrol That Comes Back
quests.story:
The recruits' first assignment is to clear the road and return together. Elian refuses the old measure of success: how much ground was gained.

Reach 12 lifetime zombie kills.
quests.aftermath: Every recruit returns. The report lists names before numbers.

quests.title: The Right to Question
quests.story:
A recruit challenges an unsafe order in front of the entire watch. Elian pauses, then asks them to explain their alternative.

Donate 8 books for the new watch charter.
quests.aftermath: The charter gives every recruit the right to ask why, and every captain the duty to answer.

quests.title: A Signature without a Rank
quests.story:
Elian finally sends the report. He keeps a copy where the new watch can read it. The last line is an account of what he will do next.

Write "an order does not erase a choice".
quests.aftermath: He signs Elian. Beneath the name, he leaves a space for corrections.

objectives.target: an order does not erase a choice
objectives.label: Write: an order does not erase a choice

quests.title: The Night Kitchen
quests.story:
No traveler should be turned away because they arrived after supper.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Roofing before the Rain
quests.story:
Mara asks for boards before the weather turns a small repair into a lost home.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Ink for Unheard Voices
quests.story:
Sera reserves a shelf for accounts that disagree with the official chronicle.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Lanterns at the Crossing
quests.story:
Iona replaces the lamps on the safest route through the marsh.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Boots by the Barracks
quests.story:
The watch has enough swords and too many people walking in wet socks.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: The Harbor Pantry
quests.story:
Fen stocks the emergency boats before the next storm warning.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Winter Bedding
quests.story:
Tamsin wants clean blankets ready before anyone needs them.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Glass for the School
quests.story:
The school needs windows more urgently than a statue of its founder.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Hinges for Open Doors
quests.story:
Mara turns iron into hinges for doors that should no longer be barred.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Seeds for New Neighbors
quests.story:
A newly arrived family wants to plant something before asking for anything else.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Arrows for the Road Watch
quests.story:
Elian keeps the watch supplied so patrols can choose distance over a reckless charge.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: Paper for the Next Map
quests.story:
The atlas needs another page. Iona considers this the best kind of problem.

Donate the listed supplies to claim emeralds. This contract renews after 20 minutes of world play time.
quests.aftermath: The shipment is recorded. The next request will be ready after the cooldown.

quests.title: A Petition in Clean Water
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXI | The Courier without a Destination
quests.story:
A courier reaches Eldara carrying a dry petition inside a soaked coat. The names on the envelope belong to a district the council has never supplied.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Eldara pins the petition beside the completed chronicle. The peace has a boundary nobody intended to draw.

objectives.label: Discuss the unlisted district with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: There is no district by that name in our ration ledger. That proves something about the ledger, not about the people. Ask Iona where the old river road ends.

objectives.label: Discuss the river road with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The road ends on my map because that was where our escorts turned back. I mistook the limit of our protection for the limit of the world.

quests.title: The Ink That Washed Away
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXI | The Courier without a Destination
quests.story:
Sera suspects the damaged address was written over an older name. Eldara asks you to preserve both accounts before choosing which one to believe.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Two names remain legible on the copied petition; neither is crossed out.

objectives.label: Discuss the overwritten address with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The upper ink is recent. Under it is a tax district abolished thirty years ago. The inhabitants kept living there after the treasury stopped counting them.

quests.title: Bootprints at the Ferry
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXI | The Courier without a Destination
quests.story:
Fen remembers collecting a family at an unofficial landing. The children called the river by a name he had never heard.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The ferry chart gains a landing described by its users, not by a royal survey.

objectives.label: Discuss the unofficial landing with Fen
objectives.dialogue: We called it an empty bank because it had no tollhouse. People were waiting there with baskets. We sailed past a harbor we did not know how to recognize.

quests.title: Put Both Maps on the Table
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXI | The Courier without a Destination
quests.story:
The address and ferry account disagree about the boundary. Eldara wants the disagreement heard by the people who must deliver relief.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The council authorizes a survey whose first instruction is to ask permission.

objectives.label: Discuss the two maps with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Fen navigates by crossings; the treasury navigated by charges. Lay one over the other and the missing district appears between the fees.

objectives.label: Discuss the relief boundary with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Then we change our delivery route. Nobody should need to prove that an old king wanted their taxes before we will share a meal.

quests.title: An Expedition with an Empty Seat
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXI | The Courier without a Destination
quests.story:
Tamsin refuses a survey party that carries instruments but no room for someone who needs to return with it.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The party leaves with a seat for a person whose name is not yet known.

objectives.label: Discuss the returning passenger with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Leave one bed and one portion unassigned. An empty place can be preparation rather than waste. Tell Elian the escort is coming home with civilians.

objectives.label: Discuss the survey escort with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Our orders are to protect the survey, not to make its witnesses agree. If they refuse us entry, we return with the refusal intact.

quests.title: A Name Spoken at the Landing
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXI | The Courier without a Destination
quests.story:
The petitioners offer no royal seal. Eldara asks you to bring back a name spoken by someone who actually lives beside the water.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: REEDBANK: a place in the common ledger, with no ownership mark beside it.

objectives.label: Discuss the river community with Fen
objectives.dialogue: They call the settlement Reedbank. Write that first. The old district title can go underneath, if it helps someone find the right boat.

objectives.label: Discuss Reedbank's petition with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: We can record Reedbank without claiming it. Ask what help they want, then ask what they wish us to leave alone.

quests.title: The Flood Marks above the Door
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXII | The Water Owes No Tribute
quests.story:
Eldara receives sketches of water lines inside homes far above the river. Tamsin thinks the damage began before the latest rain.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The survey begins upstream instead of blaming the people nearest the flood.

objectives.label: Discuss the water marks with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: The patients describe three small floods before the large one. Each time they rebuilt a little lower because the dry ground had been fenced.

objectives.label: Discuss the blocked waterway with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Three gates upstream were closed for a private mill. I cannot promise opening them fixes everything. We need the whole watercourse.

quests.title: A Bank Is More than a Line
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXII | The Water Owes No Tribute
quests.story:
Iona wants observations from an actual riverbank before the council drafts its first repair order.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The first sketch includes a floodplain, paths, gardens, and two places left deliberately open.

objectives.label: Discuss the river survey with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Mark places water can spread without taking a house with it. A narrow channel is easier to draw, but the river has never agreed to stay narrow.

quests.title: Who Sold the Dry Ground
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXII | The Water Owes No Tribute
quests.story:
Rowan has found deeds granting the same high field to three different owners. Sera needs a record that preserves the conflict.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The shelter agreement expires when the emergency ends; nobody signs away a home.

objectives.label: Discuss the competing deeds with Sera
objectives.dialogue: All three seals are authentic. The fraud was the promise that each seal made every earlier life on the land disappear.

objectives.label: Discuss the disputed field with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: For the emergency shelter, use a temporary agreement with the families. A crisis should not settle ownership for the wealthiest claimant.

quests.title: The Price of a Closed Gate
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXII | The Water Owes No Tribute
quests.story:
Mara identifies a familiar hinge in the mill drawings. Jorge has seen replacements sold as military salvage.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The repair proposal becomes an investigation into the people being paid to delay it.

objectives.label: Discuss the gate hinge with Mara
objectives.dialogue: These fittings were designed to fail open. Someone added a locking pin, then charged the downstream villages whenever it was removed.

objectives.label: Discuss the locking pins with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: I sold the pins as scrap, without knowing the contract. I kept the receipts. Take copies; a mistake is not a reason to destroy evidence.

quests.title: Ask the People below the Gate
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXII | The Water Owes No Tribute
quests.story:
Elian expects the owners to refuse inspection. Eldara insists that the plan first reach the people who live below it.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The inspection party carries invitations beside its warrants.

objectives.label: Discuss the downstream meeting with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Carry the same drawing to each landing. They need to know what a controlled release means before anyone hears a heroic speech about breaking the gate.

objectives.label: Discuss the inspection order with Elian
objectives.dialogue: We will escort engineers with witnesses from both banks. A sword can open a door and still make every useful conversation impossible.

quests.title: A Temporary Right of Passage
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXII | The Water Owes No Tribute
quests.story:
Reedbank agrees to a supervised inspection. Eldara asks Rowan to record its conditions in language the inspectors cannot conveniently forget.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The first compact is narrow, practical, and signed by people who will see one another again.

objectives.label: Discuss the passage agreement with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The community chooses its witnesses. No survey marker becomes a border. Any damage is repaired before the inspectors return home.

objectives.label: Discuss the inspection promise with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Put my workshop on the repair line. An agreement is more credible when somebody has already set aside the materials to keep it.

quests.title: The Keeper's Missing Instructions
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXIII | A Machine Built to Wait
quests.story:
Inside the recovered maintenance folio, Eldara finds repair diagrams followed by blank pages where public warnings should have been.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The investigation follows the missing warning, not a mythical machine curse.

objectives.label: Discuss the blank warning pages with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The mechanism is ordinary engineering. What is missing is the duty to tell people before moving the water. A silent gate is cheaper for its owner.

objectives.label: Discuss the maintenance folio with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The pages were removed after the diagrams were copied. We should find who kept the second copy, rather than inventing what we wish it said.

quests.title: A Signal That Can Be Checked
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXIII | A Machine Built to Wait
quests.story:
Mara asks for a small model of the warning circuit, with every connection visible to an apprentice.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The model becomes a teaching tool instead of a new source of authority.

objectives.label: Discuss the warning model with Mara
objectives.dialogue: A lit lamp means a gatekeeper has announced a change. It does not mean the river is safe. Write that distinction where everyone can read it.

quests.title: The Copy in the Tool Chest
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXIII | A Machine Built to Wait
quests.story:
Jorge finds a water-stained manual among a former gatekeeper's tools. Sera asks you to preserve it without cleaning away the handwritten objections.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The next edition gives the dismissed gatekeeper's notes their own heading.

objectives.label: Discuss the gatekeeper's tools with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: She kept a list of villages to warn. Somebody later wrote that the list was outside her duties. She kept warning them until they dismissed her.

objectives.label: Discuss the handwritten objections with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The margins tell us who tried to keep this machine humane. We will copy them at the same size as the official instructions.

quests.title: A Warning with a Return Signal
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXIII | A Machine Built to Wait
quests.story:
Iona sees a problem with a one-way alarm: isolated landings might hear it after the water arrives.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The protocol waits for the slowest landing.

objectives.label: Discuss the return signal with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Let each landing answer that its boats are clear. Silence must mean wait, not permission. Otherwise the farthest people pay for our efficiency.

objectives.label: Discuss the harbor acknowledgement with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Give the smallest ferry the same right to delay a release as the largest warehouse. It has fewer passengers, not less valuable ones.

quests.title: Practice without Raising the River
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXIII | A Machine Built to Wait
quests.story:
Eldara orders a rehearsal using lamps and written reports. Elian prepares a rescue exercise instead of an audience.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The first rehearsal is stopped twice. Mara calls both interruptions successes.

objectives.label: Discuss the rehearsal with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Every team gets to call a halt. We will practice carrying somebody home, not congratulating ourselves for assuming nobody falls.

objectives.label: Discuss the rescue station with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Put dry blankets beside the demonstration. People remember the lesson better when needing help does not become a public embarrassment.

quests.title: The Test That Was Allowed to Fail
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXIII | A Machine Built to Wait
quests.story:
A missed acknowledgement exposes a weakness in the model. Eldara asks the team to keep the failed test in the public record.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The common works ledger opens with an error and the cost of correcting it.

objectives.label: Discuss the failed test with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Do not polish this into a tale of flawless engineers. The interruption found the mistake while it was still only a lamp.

objectives.label: Discuss the public record with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The budget will include another rehearsal. If we fund only successful demonstrations, we teach people to hide the useful ones.

quests.title: Ships Arriving Empty
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
Fen reports boats returning with empty holds despite signed delivery receipts. Eldara asks you to compare the promises with the actual meals.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Eldara orders immediate supplies while the investigation continues.

objectives.label: Discuss the empty holds with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The crews delivered everything on their manifests. The manifests themselves were shortened at the bonded warehouse. Blaming the sailors would be convenient.

objectives.label: Discuss the missing meals with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: The pantry has been stretching portions for six days. Nobody complained because each household thought another household needed the food more.

quests.title: Food before an Explanation
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
The relief kitchen needs a delivery now. Its patients cannot eat a promise that the accounts will eventually be corrected.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The kitchen separates its serving tables from the investigators' desks.

objectives.label: Discuss the emergency kitchen with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Thank you. We will serve the meal before asking anyone for testimony. Hunger can make a witness agree with whoever holds the ladle.

quests.title: The Duplicate Receipt
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
Sera discovers identical cargo numbers on shipments supposedly bound for opposite banks.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The evidence points to the Ledger House, a consortium surviving the fall of the royal court.

objectives.label: Discuss the duplicated receipt with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The second receipt carries a warehouse fee for goods that never passed through its doors. The missing food became a charge before it became a shortage.

objectives.label: Discuss the warehouse stamp with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: I recognize the stamp maker's work. The mark is real; the claim is false. Keep asking what a document does, not just whether it looks authentic.

quests.title: The Cost of Keeping Quiet
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
A witness fears losing passage if the warehouse owners learn they spoke. Iona proposes a route with several safe returns.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The witness agrees to speak when the route home is explained first.

objectives.label: Discuss the witness route with Iona
objectives.dialogue: No secret tunnel, no miraculous escape. Three ordinary hosts who know the next host, and a boat that can turn back at every stage.

objectives.label: Discuss the witness passage with Fen
objectives.dialogue: I will reserve places without publishing the passengers. Public spending needs an account; endangered people do not need a public itinerary.

quests.title: A Hold Reserved for Repairs
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
Mara argues that relief voyages fail when every departure is full and no boat can carry broken equipment home.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The fleet begins measuring successful returns alongside delivered weight.

objectives.label: Discuss the repair cargo with Mara
objectives.dialogue: A full outbound hold looks impressive on a report. Leave space on the return. Broken pumps and exhausted people also need passage.

objectives.label: Discuss the return manifest with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The next manifest lists room kept empty for emergencies. I expect the accountants to object. They can help load it.

quests.title: A Fleet outside the Warehouse
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
The captains agree to bypass the Ledger House for emergency relief. Eldara asks how to keep that emergency power from becoming permanent.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The emergency fleet departs under a charter with an ending written into it.

objectives.label: Discuss the emergency charter with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Set a date for review and publish the costs. Necessary action should leave behind a way to end itself.

objectives.label: Discuss the captains' charter with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Every captain signs the same limit. We are opening a route, not founding another house that owns the river.

quests.title: A Wall That Leans Downstream
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXV | Stone for the Common Works
quests.story:
The survey locates a damaged retaining wall. Mara refuses to estimate repairs from the tidy outline in the warehouse plan.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The repair schedule begins with consent and a foundation survey.

objectives.label: Discuss the retaining wall with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Someone drew the face of the wall and left out its foundations. We need to know what carries the weight before adding anything to it.

objectives.label: Discuss the wall approaches with Iona
objectives.dialogue: There are two routes to inspect it. One crosses a working garden; ask its keeper before calling it the convenient route.

quests.title: The Quarry's Quiet Shift
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXV | Stone for the Common Works
