quests.story:
Elian reports that quarry workers stopped ringing the change-of-shift bell because the sound attracted nearby dead.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: A regular watch replaces a dangerous custom nobody had meant to make permanent.

objectives.label: Discuss the quarry watch with Elian
objectives.dialogue: We can protect the shift change. We cannot ask workers to keep silent forever because we find patrols inconvenient.

objectives.label: Discuss the quarry threat with Caelen
objectives.dialogue: Watch the approach routes, not just the kill count. A cleared path needs someone assigned to notice when it becomes dangerous again.

quests.title: What the Stone Is Worth
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXV | Stone for the Common Works
quests.story:
Jorge sees the proposed stone price triple after the common works announcement. He offers his old invoices for comparison.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The procurement contract gains a line for wages the council can actually inspect.

objectives.label: Discuss the stone invoices with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: The old price barely paid the cutters. The new price barely reaches them. Ask where the difference goes before calling either price fair.

objectives.label: Discuss the workers' payment with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Then the contract names the workers' share and the delivery costs separately. A low public price is not a victory if someone else absorbs the injury.

quests.title: The Mason's Practical Objection
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXV | Stone for the Common Works
quests.story:
Mara asks for a model that shows drainage gaps. Rowan wants to know why the wall must deliberately admit water.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The model remains visibly imperfect in a way that can be explained.

objectives.label: Discuss the drainage gaps with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Because holding every drop back puts the whole hillside behind the wall. Some strength comes from allowing a pressure to pass.

objectives.label: Discuss the revised design with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Keep the explanation with the model. Otherwise a future steward will spend good money filling the gaps to make it look finished.

quests.title: No Work without a Way Home
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXV | Stone for the Common Works
quests.story:
Tamsin finds workers sleeping beside the stone stacks to avoid the fare. Fen offers a shift ferry.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The first workers leave at the end of their shift without calculating whether they can afford to.

objectives.label: Discuss the overnight workers with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Nobody chose this because a stone yard is restful. Put transport in the work budget before praising their dedication.

objectives.label: Discuss the shift ferry with Fen
objectives.dialogue: One trip for the first shift, one for the last, and room for tools. Reliable passage is less glamorous than rescue and usually prevents it.

quests.title: The Foundation Nobody Will See
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXV | Stone for the Common Works
quests.story:
The repair is ready for public approval. Eldara asks Mara to describe the work that will disappear beneath the finished road.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The dedication begins with the workers who will not appear in its most attractive painting.

objectives.label: Discuss the hidden foundation with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Drainage, good footing, and someone willing to stop when the ground behaves differently from the drawing. Put their names beside the ribbon cutters.

objectives.label: Discuss the builders' record with Sera
objectives.dialogue: I will keep the rejected plans too. The finished road deserves an honest account of what made it safe.

quests.title: An Invitation with Conditions
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVI | The House Made of Paper
quests.story:
The Ledger House invites the council to negotiate, provided no river witnesses attend. Eldara sends the invitation for public reading.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The reply accepts a meeting and rejects the empty seats.

objectives.label: Discuss the invitation's conditions with Sera
objectives.dialogue: They offer to settle the dispute by removing the people who can describe it. We can decline the condition without declining to listen.

objectives.label: Discuss the negotiation seats with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Reedbank chooses its own delegation. We will pay their passage and let them disagree with us in the room.

quests.title: A Debt Older than Its Debtor
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVI | The House Made of Paper
quests.story:
The House claims that the river communities inherited unpaid royal maintenance charges. Sera asks who actually received the maintenance.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The council separates verifiable costs from fees that have survived only on paper.

objectives.label: Discuss the inherited debt with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The charge continued through years when the gates were abandoned. It is an account of an obligation, with the service quietly removed.

objectives.label: Discuss the old maintenance voyages with Fen
objectives.dialogue: My predecessor ferried the repair crews only twice in that period. I will testify to the journeys I know, and leave the rest uncertain.

quests.title: The Guard at the Archive Door
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVI | The House Made of Paper
quests.story:
Elian warns that the archive staff are being treated as accomplices because they handled the House's records.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Staff are offered protection without being asked to endorse the council's account.

objectives.label: Discuss the archive staff with Spire Guard
objectives.dialogue: My order is to keep the records safe and the door open to authorized witnesses. Clerks may leave their shift. This is an archive, not a prison.

objectives.label: Discuss the staff protections with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Investigate decisions, not proximity to a desk. A frightened clerk can preserve evidence; a cornered one may burn it to escape.

quests.title: The Margin Reserved for Dissent
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVI | The House Made of Paper
quests.story:
Reedbank's witnesses disagree with Rowan's preferred settlement. Eldara asks you to carry their objection without softening it.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The settlement remains a proposal long enough for people to change it.

objectives.label: Discuss the dissenting petition with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: They think our review date is too late. Write it exactly that way. Agreement loses its meaning if we edit every refusal into a compliment.

objectives.label: Discuss the dissenting record with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The objection goes beside the draft, not in a separate volume nobody reads. Future readers should see that another course was proposed.

quests.title: A Bond with No Hostage
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVI | The House Made of Paper
quests.story:
The House offers repair materials if the council guarantees future toll income. Mara asks who bears the risk if the repairs fail.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The common works choose several modest contracts over one irresistible bargain.

objectives.label: Discuss the repair bond with Mara
objectives.dialogue: They receive the toll even if the wall fails. That is no guarantee of workmanship. Payment should follow inspected work, not a promise to keep collecting.

objectives.label: Discuss the material guarantee with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: We can buy smaller lots from several suppliers. It takes more checking, but one angry owner cannot strand the entire repair.

quests.title: The Meeting after the Meeting
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVI | The House Made of Paper
quests.story:
The formal hearing ends without agreement. Eldara asks whether the witnesses still have a reason to return.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: A second meeting is scheduled in the river district itself.

objectives.label: Discuss the witnesses' return with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Their boats are waiting, their expenses are covered, and nobody has hidden the next meeting date. That will matter more than a gracious closing speech.

objectives.label: Discuss the next hearing with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: We keep negotiating. Refusing one set of terms is not the same as declaring every possible agreement impossible.

quests.title: A Rumor before the Hearing
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVII | The Night of Open Doors
quests.story:
A rumor claims the council intends to seize every river boat. Fen asks Eldara to publish the actual draft before fear writes another one.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Copies of the proposal reach the landings before the next official speech.

objectives.label: Discuss the seizure rumor with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Some captains believed it because a king once did exactly that. Do not call them foolish. Show them the clause that prevents us repeating it.

objectives.label: Discuss the public draft with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The boats remain with their crews. We can pay for passage without owning the people who provide it.

quests.title: The Watch at a Public Meeting
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVII | The Night of Open Doors
quests.story:
Elian expects an angry crowd. Tamsin asks where someone can leave quietly if the room becomes too much.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The meeting plan includes several ways to participate and several ways to leave.

objectives.label: Discuss the meeting watch with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Guards stand where they can keep exits clear. Nobody is searched merely for arriving with an argument.

objectives.label: Discuss the quiet room with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: A seat outside is still a place in the meeting. We can carry questions between rooms without making anyone earn the right to be heard.

quests.title: A Translation of the Same Promise
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVII | The Night of Open Doors
quests.story:
Iona finds that the river names in the public draft are unfamiliar to half its intended readers.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The agreement acquires a glossary written by its readers.

objectives.label: Discuss the translated map with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Put the landing names beside the survey names. People should not need to abandon the words they use at home to understand a public promise.

objectives.label: Discuss the parallel text with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Keep both versions together, with a place to record corrections. A translation becomes dangerous when it is treated as an invisible convenience.

quests.title: The Testimony Nobody Expected
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVII | The Night of Open Doors
quests.story:
Jorge offers to describe his own sales to the gate owners. Elian worries the hearing will become a contest to identify one convenient culprit.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The hearing records a responsibility that neither excuses nor explains away the whole system.

objectives.label: Discuss the public testimony with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: I want the receipts read before my apology. An apology can sound generous while leaving the useful facts safely unnamed.

objectives.label: Discuss the witness's protection with Elian
objectives.dialogue: He can answer questions without being handed to a crowd. Accountability needs room for an answer, even an unsatisfactory one.

quests.title: A Vote That Can Be Revisited
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVII | The Night of Open Doors
quests.story:
The delegates disagree about how often to review the river compact. Eldara asks each side to state the cost of its preferred timetable.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The council budgets for participation before selecting the review date.

objectives.label: Discuss the compact review with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: A short review keeps the agreement answerable but makes planning harder. A long one gives stability and more time for a bad rule to hurt people.

objectives.label: Discuss the distant delegates with Iona
objectives.dialogue: If reviews are frequent, pay for distant delegates to attend. Otherwise proximity becomes an extra vote nobody wrote into the charter.

quests.title: The First Shared Signature
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.section: XXVII | The Night of Open Doors
quests.story:
The compact is ready. Eldara asks you to recommend how its first season will be supervised.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The compact is signed with a review date and a clear right to call a halt.

objectives.label: Discuss the shared signature with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The captains will sign either arrangement if river communities can stop an unsafe release. Keep that right in the part everyone signs.

objectives.label: Discuss the first season with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: We will record your recommendation and the objections to it. Neither arrangement should survive merely because admitting a mistake would be embarrassing.

choices.title: Rotating local stewards
choices.result: Each landing names a steward for one season. The record emphasizes local scrutiny and the work required to keep handovers clear.

choices.title: A joint river council
choices.result: A shared council supervises the first season. The record emphasizes continuity and the cost of keeping distant communities represented.

quests.title: Before Anyone Opens a Gate
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
The compact has been signed, but the first controlled release still requires preparations at every landing.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Readiness is reported as a set of answered questions, not a single triumphant word.

objectives.label: Discuss the ready boats with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Every landing has answered. Two asked for extra time, and received it. The agreement has begun doing its job before the gate has moved.

objectives.label: Discuss the evacuation check with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: The people who need assistance have chosen where to wait. We asked them before deciding what safety ought to look like.

quests.title: The Engineer's Last Objection
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
Mara finds a worn fitting during the final inspection. The ceremony can wait; the water cannot be asked to ignore it.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The ceremony is postponed, and the postponement appears in the official account.

objectives.label: Discuss the worn fitting with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Replace it now. Nobody gets a medal for keeping a schedule that was written before the fault was found.

objectives.label: Discuss the replacement stock with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: The spare lot is here because we bought it before the emergency. Boring inventory has finally had its moment.

quests.title: Make Room for the River
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
Iona marks a floodplain that must remain free of new buildings. Rowan asks how to protect it without evicting its present users.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The floodplain agreement includes seed, compensation, and a date to return.

objectives.label: Discuss the shared floodplain with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Seasonal gardens can return after the water. Permanent walls cannot. Ask the growers what warning and support make the arrangement workable.

objectives.label: Discuss the growers' agreement with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: We pay for the lost season before the release. Nobody should have to fund a public benefit with a private disaster.

quests.title: When the Warning Comes Back
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
The trial release proceeds in the chronicle. Eldara asks you to collect reports from the watch and harbor before declaring it complete.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The report includes the improvement requested by the least powerful landing.

objectives.label: Discuss the first release report with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The watch reports no missing people. One path washed out sooner than expected. Put both facts in the same report.

objectives.label: Discuss the harbor report with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The small landing was safe. The warning arrived with time to spare. Its keeper still wants a clearer signal, and I have promised a second test.

quests.title: Return the Borrowed Ground
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
Emergency shelters stand on borrowed land. Eldara asks Rowan and Tamsin to agree on departures that do not leave people homeless again.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The last shelter remains open under a new agreement, with its costs acknowledged.

objectives.label: Discuss the shelter agreement with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The emergency has ended for the council before it has ended for every family. We negotiate extensions openly instead of pretending the original promise never existed.

objectives.label: Discuss the last shelter residents with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Let each household leave with a plan, not a deadline alone. Recovery is not a ceremony everyone reaches on the same morning.

quests.title: A Road That Belongs to Its Travelers
quests.chapter: Book IV | The Roads That Remember
quests.story:
Eldara gathers the maps, objections, repair reports, and landing names into a fourth book. One courier arrives before its cover is dry.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: BOOK IV COMPLETE. The river has room to move. Beyond it, the first northern snow is falling.

objectives.label: Discuss the fourth book with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Leave the compact's review pages loose. A book can preserve what happened without pretending that no amendment will ever be needed.

objectives.label: Discuss the winter courier with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The courier came from above the northern passes. Their village is absent from both our old maps and the new river ledger. They ask whether winter must be survived alone.

quests.title: The Courier Who Kept Walking
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXIX | A Letter above the Snowline
quests.story:
The northern courier waited through the river hearing rather than interrupt it. Eldara asks what was urgent enough to bring them so far.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Eldara opens a fifth book with the courier's own account, including the days they waited.

objectives.label: Discuss the northern letter with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The address is White Cairn. I have a height mark for it and no road. Someone measured the mountain without recording the people living on it.

objectives.label: Discuss the courier's condition with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: They need rest before questions. I have their permission to tell you that the villages face a fuel shortage, and that the first pass is already closing.

quests.title: A Village beyond the Stamp
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXIX | A Letter above the Snowline
quests.story:
Rowan finds no agreement promising White Cairn relief. Sera asks whether the absence is an answer or the reason a new agreement is needed.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The invitation asks what help is wanted without claiming a forgotten right to govern.

objectives.label: Discuss the absent agreement with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: We have never promised these villages anything. That limits what they can demand from an old charter; it does not limit what we can offer now.

objectives.label: Discuss the northern records with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Do not invent an ancient bond to make present kindness respectable. Record the first offer as the first offer.

quests.title: Enough for the Return
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXIX | A Letter above the Snowline
quests.story:
Fen cannot sail a mountain pass, but he recognizes a supply plan that spends everything on arrival.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The supplies include a return journey and a written condition for abandoning the attempt.

objectives.label: Discuss the expedition reserve with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Count the return rations separately. A party dependent on taking food from its hosts has not arrived bringing only help.

objectives.label: Discuss the northern escort with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The escort has permission to turn back. No courier should have to keep walking merely because their report might disappoint us.

quests.title: Two Calendars for One Winter
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXIX | A Letter above the Snowline
quests.story:
The council calls the pass open until first snow. Iona learns that local carriers stop using it much earlier.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Departure is moved forward and unfinished comforts are left behind.

objectives.label: Discuss the carriers' calendar with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The locals watch the night ice in shaded cuts. Our calendar waits for a snowfall people in the valley can see. Their winter begins sooner.

objectives.label: Discuss the expedition timetable with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Then the workshop deadline moves. A date is a tool for organizing work, not a law that makes conditions obey it.

quests.title: The Words on the Welcome
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXIX | A Letter above the Snowline
quests.story:
Sera drafts an introduction that promises partnership. Ysolde wants the party to explain what refusing that partnership would mean.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Three separate offers travel north in one envelope.

objectives.label: Discuss the northern introduction with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: Say they can refuse the survey and still accept blankets. Otherwise the blankets become a price paid for permission.

objectives.label: Discuss the offer without conditions with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The letter now separates relief, mapping, and a possible compact. A yes to one will not be copied into the other two.

quests.title: Above the Last Road Sign
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXIX | A Letter above the Snowline
quests.story:
The expedition reaches the edge of its reliable map in the chronicle. Eldara asks who will choose the next step.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The expedition crosses its first boundary by accepting that someone else knows the ground.

objectives.label: Discuss the last marked road with Iona
objectives.dialogue: From here we follow the local carrier's route. I will draw what they permit and mark what they ask us to leave unrecorded.

objectives.label: Discuss the guide's authority with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The guide can call a halt without arguing with my rank. Everyone in the escort has heard that order from me.

quests.title: Snow Is Not Empty Ground
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXX | The Pass That Changes Overnight
quests.story:
Iona asks for observations from a snowy plain before equipment is assigned for the high pass.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The route gains planned stops instead of a single heroic distance.

objectives.label: Discuss the snow survey with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The smooth places are not always the safe ones. Mark wind, shelter, and the route back to the last known footing.

objectives.label: Discuss the cold-weather stops with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Rest stops need shelter before people become exhausted. Waiting until someone cannot continue leaves us choosing under worse conditions.

quests.title: A Rope Longer than a Promise
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXX | The Pass That Changes Overnight
quests.story:
Mara prepares rescue lines and asks Elian who is allowed to order an unsafe rescue.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The crossing plan gives every traveler a partner and every partner a route to safety.

objectives.label: Discuss the rescue lines with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Inspect the fastening and keep a spare. Courage will not mend a cut line halfway through a crossing.

objectives.label: Discuss the rescue limit with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Nobody is required to become a second casualty to prove loyalty. We will plan a rescue before the emergency, including when to stop.

quests.title: The Bell beneath the Drift
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXX | The Pass That Changes Overnight
quests.story:
A shelter bell lies buried after a storm. Fen proposes visual markers for days when sound disappears in the wind.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The marked route offers both directions with equal clarity.

objectives.label: Discuss the lost shelter bell with Fen
objectives.dialogue: At sea we never depend on one signal. Keep the bell, add a light, and tell travelers what either signal actually means.

objectives.label: Discuss the shelter markers with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Each marker points to the next shelter and back to this one. A sign should help someone abandon a journey as well as continue it.

quests.title: The Pass Keeper's Refusal
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXX | The Pass That Changes Overnight
quests.story:
The keeper of a narrow crossing refuses the expedition permission to continue. Eldara asks you to carry the reason without turning it into an insult.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Two smaller deliveries replace the single journey that could no longer be made safely.

objectives.label: Discuss the refused crossing with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The ice shifted last night. We hired their judgment; now we use it. Tell the council the party is delayed by a decision that may have saved it.

objectives.label: Discuss the delayed relief with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Send support by the lower route. Do not make the keeper responsible for every consequence of refusing one unsafe passage.

quests.title: Warmth at the Turnaround
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXX | The Pass That Changes Overnight
quests.story:
Tamsin asks for a shelter where turning back does not mean going without food.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The expedition loses time without losing its way home.

objectives.label: Discuss the turnaround shelter with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: A retreat should lead somewhere warm. People take terrible risks when the safe choice looks like punishment.

objectives.label: Discuss the lower-route supplies with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The boats can carry supplies to the foothills while the pass is closed. We have a useful job even when we cannot finish the whole route.

quests.title: The Guide Draws the Boundary
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXX | The Pass That Changes Overnight
quests.story:
White Cairn permits the expedition to enter by the lower path but asks that a protected ridge stay off public maps.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The first northern map includes a blank space that is there by agreement.

objectives.label: Discuss the protected ridge with Iona
objectives.dialogue: I can mark the boundary without recording what lies inside it. A useful map need not satisfy every curiosity.

objectives.label: Discuss the ridge agreement with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: Keeping a promise of privacy is part of arriving peacefully. The villages will notice whether we respect a small refusal before trusting us with a larger one.

quests.title: A Warehouse with a Warm Office
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXI | The Warmth in Someone Else's Ledger
quests.story:
The villages have timber but little seasoned fuel. Jorge recognizes a contract that charges storage fees while delaying delivery.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The inquiry opens with records that can contradict one another.

objectives.label: Discuss the winter fuel contract with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: The supplier earns more while the fuel waits. That does not prove every delay was deliberate, but it gives us a reason to inspect the dates.

objectives.label: Discuss the delivery records with Sera
objectives.dialogue: We compare signed receipts, weather reports, and the carriers' accounts. A neat pattern in one ledger is a question, not yet a verdict.

quests.title: Burning the Next Year
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXI | The Warmth in Someone Else's Ledger
quests.story:
Mara worries that emergency cutting will consume the seedlings needed for future fuel.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The relief plan reserves future growth before expanding the fuel harvest.

objectives.label: Discuss the charcoal trial with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Measure the wood used as well as the heat gained. A method can solve tonight by making next winter worse.

objectives.label: Discuss the fuel gardens with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Keep seed trees and leave the slopes that shelter the village. A bare hillside changes more than the woodpile.

quests.title: An Account beside Every Hearth
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXI | The Warmth in Someone Else's Ledger
quests.story:
Rowan wants household estimates. Tamsin warns that an inventory of private need can become a list people are ashamed to join.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The public report shows the gap without displaying the households inside it.

objectives.label: Discuss the household estimates with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Ask what warmth is needed, not why a household deserves it. Keep individual details with the people arranging deliveries.

objectives.label: Discuss the public fuel account with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Publish totals and shortages. The council can be answerable without publishing whose children sleep in which room.

quests.title: A Fair Price for a Difficult Road
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXI | The Warmth in Someone Else's Ledger
quests.story:
The carriers refuse the council's proposed rate. Fen asks why a dangerous mountain delivery was priced like a short river crossing.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The contract pays for safe decisions that produce no impressive arrival.

objectives.label: Discuss the carrier rate with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The old figure counted distance and ignored weather, return loads, and days waiting safely. Underpaying caution encourages someone to skip it.

objectives.label: Discuss the revised delivery price with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: Pay the waiting time when the pass is closed. Then a safe delay is a cost we share, not a loss pushed onto the driver.

quests.title: The Storekeeper Who Stayed
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXI | The Warmth in Someone Else's Ledger
quests.story:
The local storekeeper admits keeping a reserve secret, fearing a rush on supplies. Eldara wants a workable remedy as well as an honest account.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The reserve becomes part of the relief plan under an account everyone can inspect.

objectives.label: Discuss the hidden reserve with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Bring the stock into the common count, record the decision, and protect access to the store. Shame alone will not distribute a single basket fairly.

objectives.label: Discuss the storehouse watch with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The watch will prevent threats and report shortages. It will not decide whose stove matters most.

quests.title: Enough Heat to Disagree
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXI | The Warmth in Someone Else's Ledger
quests.story:
The fuel committee can choose local stores or a shared reserve. Eldara asks whose failure would be easiest to repair.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: Fuel reaches the villages under a plan with published stocks and a spring review.

objectives.label: Discuss the reserve arrangement with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Several stores resist one broken roof. One common store is easier to inspect. Either needs people with time and tools to keep it sound.

objectives.label: Discuss the winter reserve decision with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Choose the first arrangement, then write how to change it. A winter trial should not become a permanent law by accident.

choices.title: Several village stores
choices.result: Local stores receive separate inspections and mutual-aid commitments. The spring review will compare shortages between villages.

choices.title: One shared reserve
choices.result: A shared reserve publishes daily stock figures and keeps local emergency caches. The spring review will examine access and travel costs.

quests.title: The Observatory on the Old Map
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXII | A Light That Answers No King
quests.story:
Sera finds an abandoned observatory overlooking the pass. Its last keeper recorded weather long after royal payments stopped.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The expedition seeks permission to restore a weather station, not a royal outpost.

objectives.label: Discuss the keeper's notebooks with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The final years have the most careful observations and the fewest signatures. Nobody paid for the work, so the palace assumed it had ended.

objectives.label: Discuss the observatory route with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The ridge can be approached without entering the protected ground. I will ask the guides to check that before drawing a public path.

quests.title: Glass for a Patient Window
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXII | A Light That Answers No King
quests.story:
Mara says the observation room needs reliable windows more than an impressive new tower.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The restoration budget begins with ordinary comfort and overlapping shifts.

objectives.label: Discuss the observation room with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Weather work requires people to stay long enough to notice a change. Start with a dry room and a chair that does not break.

objectives.label: Discuss the observers' rota with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: No one keeps the entire night watch alone. Fatigue can look like dedication until it becomes a missed warning.

quests.title: A Warning without a Command
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXII | A Light That Answers No King
quests.story:
Elian asks how weather reports become decisions. Iona wants the station to explain uncertainty without issuing travel orders.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The warning code separates observation, uncertainty, and local judgment.

objectives.label: Discuss the warning signals with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Use separate signals for observed danger and uncertain conditions. If every light means absolute certainty, someone will wait too long to light it.

objectives.label: Discuss the station's authority with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The station reports what it sees. The route keepers decide passage using that report and the ground beneath their feet.

quests.title: Three Nights in the Margin
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXII | A Light That Answers No King
quests.story:
The old notebook contains three contradictory wind reports. Sera asks you to keep them together while Mara checks the instrument.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The recovered record includes the circumstances of its own mistakes.

objectives.label: Discuss the old wind instrument with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The vane catches when ice builds on the bearing. One observer freed it; another recorded it as found. Both wrote honestly about different conditions.

objectives.label: Discuss the contradictory reports with Sera
objectives.dialogue: We add the instrument fault beside the entries. Correcting the explanation does not require erasing the evidence that led us to it.

quests.title: A Beacon for Those below
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXII | A Light That Answers No King
quests.story:
Fen proposes testing the warning from the landing that most needs to see it.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The warning network gains a modest relay after an unsuccessful public test.

objectives.label: Discuss the distant signal test with Fen
objectives.dialogue: From the tower it is brilliant. From the lower landing it disappears behind a roof. A signal works where it is received, not where it is admired.

objectives.label: Discuss the relay position with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Place a relay with the landing keeper's agreement and test it in poor weather. A clear day proves only what happens on a clear day.

quests.title: The First Forecast Nobody Owns
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXII | A Light That Answers No King
quests.story:
The station is ready. Eldara asks Sera and Rowan to settle who may read its observations.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The restored light answers the weather and the people who travel beneath it.

objectives.label: Discuss the open forecasts with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Copies go to carriers, villages, and anyone maintaining a route. Nobody should need permission from a patron to learn that a storm is coming.

objectives.label: Discuss the station charter with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The council pays its share without owning the forecasts. Local observers keep authority over their work and publish corrections beside predictions.

quests.title: Tracks beside the Woodpile
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.story:
Ysolde reports that a displaced dragon has been following fuel caravans. Elian wants the observation distinguished from an attack report.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The caravans secure their food and keep a cautious distance.

objectives.label: Discuss the caravan tracks with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: The tracks stop where spilled food was left. That may explain the visits; it does not make approaching the animal safe. Change the storage before organizing a hunt.

objectives.label: Discuss the caravan watch with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The watch keeps people back and records behavior. We will respond to an actual threat without pretending every footprint is one.

quests.title: A Refuge Cannot Be a Trap
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.story:
Tamsin and Ysolde consider a temporary refuge away from homes. Iona checks that it does not block a customary village route.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The proposal reserves safe passage for residents, keepers, and the displaced creature.

objectives.label: Discuss the proposed refuge with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The apparently empty gap is the winter footpath. Move the boundary or people will have to choose between trespass and a dangerous detour.

objectives.label: Discuss the refuge exits with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: Leave a route for the animal to depart and a separate route for keepers to retreat. A refuge with no exits becomes a confrontation waiting for a bad day.

quests.title: The Cost of Keeping Distance
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.story:
Jorge asks who pays for ruined provisions. Rowan refuses a policy that demands patience from people while leaving them with the loss.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: A small compensation fund accompanies the refuge rules.

objectives.label: Discuss the damaged provisions with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: Compensation needs a clear claim and a date for payment. A sympathetic speech does not replace a winter food stock.

objectives.label: Discuss the refuge compensation with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The common fund covers verified losses and prevention supplies. People can support restraint more readily when they are not asked to subsidize it alone.

quests.title: Listen before Naming It Hunger
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.story:
Tamsin wants the keepers to record several explanations for the visits rather than making one guess into a fact.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The log leaves room for observations that challenge its opening theory.

objectives.label: Discuss the observation log with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Record the weather, noise, food, and the animal's route. We may discover a pattern, or learn that our first theory was too simple.

objectives.label: Discuss the keepers' observations with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: Let an unanswered question stay unanswered. Calling uncertainty expertise makes the next mistake harder to admit.

quests.title: No Trophy for a Quiet Week
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.story:
Caelen says a week without an attack should count as success even if the watch cannot display proof on a wall.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The refuge watch publishes a week of safe passage and several prudent withdrawals.

objectives.label: Discuss the quiet refuge watch with Caelen
objectives.dialogue: The best outcome gives us no trophy. I will sign a contract for safe journeys and careful reports, not for producing a carcass to prove we worked.

objectives.label: Discuss the watch report with Elian
objectives.dialogue: We record the protected trips and the times we withdrew. A retreat that avoids an injury belongs in a successful report.

quests.title: The Path Left Open
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.story:
The dragon moves on in the chronicle. Eldara asks what should remain after the temporary refuge closes.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The refuge ends with the return of a path and an account of what it cost.

objectives.label: Discuss the empty refuge with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: Keep the observations and the safe-distance rules. Remove the temporary barriers before someone mistakes them for a claim on the valley.

objectives.label: Discuss the reopened footpath with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The path goes back on the public map after the residents check it. Restoration is a task, not something we assume happens when we stop using a place.

quests.title: A Register with Too Few Lines
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXIV | The Names below the Totals
quests.story:
The relief register counts buildings. Tamsin knows several households share the same roof.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The next delivery includes households the first calculation concealed.

objectives.label: Discuss the crowded register with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: One roof is not one household. Ask the residents how supplies are shared instead of dividing a total by the number of doors.

objectives.label: Discuss the revised relief count with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: We correct the allocation and publish the reason. A mistaken count can be repaired without making the people it missed prove they were inconveniently real.

quests.title: The Name Someone Does Not Use
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXIV | The Names below the Totals
quests.story:
Sera finds that the old royal register records a villager under a name they have left behind.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The working register is corrected without demanding a public explanation.

objectives.label: Discuss the corrected name with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Their current name belongs in the working register. The old document can remain in the archive with access limited where it could cause harm.

objectives.label: Discuss the register correction with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: No public hearing is needed to make a clerk use the right name. We can audit the change without turning a person's history into an exhibit.

quests.title: Letters Held through Winter
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXIV | The Names below the Totals
quests.story:
Fen has a bundle of letters delayed by the closed pass. Elian wants families warned that a late message may describe an earlier danger.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The letters arrive with a delivery history and an honest account of the remaining gaps.

objectives.label: Discuss the delayed letters with Fen
objectives.dialogue: I will preserve the dates and say when each bundle traveled. Silence in winter can mean a blocked road, not an abandoned promise.

objectives.label: Discuss the families' notice with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Give families what we know and what we cannot yet know. Do not fill a frightening silence with reassurance we have no evidence for.

quests.title: A Witness Can Change Their Mind
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXIV | The Names below the Totals
quests.story:
A village speaker withdraws permission to include their story in the public chronicle. Eldara asks Sera to honor the request before printing.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The chronicle gains a statement of its limits instead of a story taken against its teller's wishes.

objectives.label: Discuss the withdrawn testimony with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The public copy will omit it. We can explain that a contribution was withdrawn without hinting at what it said.

objectives.label: Discuss the survey consent with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The same rule belongs in the map notes. Agreement given during an emergency should have a way to be reconsidered afterward.

quests.title: Those Who Remain Missing
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXIV | The Names below the Totals
quests.story:
The winter list still contains unanswered names. Tamsin asks for a place where families can leave new information without repeating their loss at every desk.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The search continues under a record designed to survive changes of staff.

objectives.label: Discuss the missing-person desk with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Give each family one contact and a way to update the record. We cannot promise an answer; we can stop making them begin again each time they ask.

objectives.label: Discuss the search handover with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The watch will pass on leads with dates and sources. An unverified sighting remains a lead, not an announcement of a return.

quests.title: A Chronicle with Blank Pages
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXIV | The Names below the Totals
quests.story:
Eldara asks how to close a chapter while its missing names remain unresolved.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The fifth book keeps blank pages whose purpose is explicitly named.

objectives.label: Discuss the unfinished register with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Close the account of this winter, not the search. Leave a dated page for later answers and say who will keep it.

objectives.label: Discuss the next keeper with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: The families know where to bring news. That is a smaller promise than certainty, and one we can actually keep.

quests.title: An Invitation That Pays the Fare
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXV | Seats for the People beyond the Map
quests.story:
The northern villages are invited to a spring council. Fen asks whether the invitation includes the cost of arriving.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The council funds participation before deciding how many chairs to set out.

objectives.label: Discuss the delegates' passage with Fen
objectives.dialogue: A seat is not accessible if reaching it costs a household its seed money. Put fares and lodging beside the invitation.

objectives.label: Discuss the council budget with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The travel fund is open to every delegation by the same published rule. Attendance should not depend on a private favor from a steward.

quests.title: A Delegate Is Not a Village
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXV | Seats for the People beyond the Map
quests.story:
Iona asks how distant residents can challenge a delegate who claims unanimous support.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The council packet includes limits, objections, and a route for asking again.

objectives.label: Discuss the delegates' mandate with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Record what each delegate has permission to agree to, and what they must take home for discussion. Distance should not turn consultation into a blank signature.

objectives.label: Discuss the dissenting letters with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Letters of disagreement travel with the mandate. A village can send one delegate and still have more than one opinion.

quests.title: The Watch outside the Council
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXV | Seats for the People beyond the Map
quests.story:
Elian wants guards available for safety without making military presence part of the negotiation.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The watch briefing describes service at a meeting rather than control over it.

objectives.label: Discuss the council watch with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The guards stay at the entrances and respond to specific threats. A delegate should not have to agree beneath a row of drawn weapons.

objectives.label: Discuss the delegates' access with Spire Guard
objectives.dialogue: I have the access list and instructions to help people find the meeting. Disagreement with the council is not a reason to refuse entry.

quests.title: The Offer a Village May Refuse
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXV | Seats for the People beyond the Map
quests.story:
One northern village wants weather reports and no shared government. Rowan asks whether cooperation can survive that answer.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The council writes a place for cooperation outside membership.

objectives.label: Discuss the limited agreement with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Yes. Share the reports, keep the relief account, and leave membership for them to reconsider. Help already given is not a debt payable in sovereignty.

objectives.label: Discuss the refused membership with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: Then make the limited agreement visible. Other villages should know that refusing a wider compact does not make them enemies.

quests.title: The Amendment Written after Supper
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXV | Seats for the People beyond the Map
quests.story:
A late proposal would move disputes to a court too far away for most villagers to use. Jorge asks who can afford to be right there.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The vote is delayed until the amendment can be read outside the meeting room.

objectives.label: Discuss the distant court clause with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: A good rule with an unreachable hearing can protect only the people who travel easily. Start with a local hearing and publish a route for appeal.

objectives.label: Discuss the late amendment with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Circulate the new clause before voting. Exhaustion and surprise are poor substitutes for agreement.

quests.title: A Covenant with Open Edges
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXV | Seats for the People beyond the Map
quests.story:
Eldara asks you to recommend the first structure for northern cooperation. Both drafts protect the right to refuse broader membership.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The northern covenant is adopted for a trial year with local ratification and a published review.

objectives.label: Discuss the northern covenant with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: A federation shares decisions and the work of attending them. A network of agreements is easier to join narrowly and harder to coordinate. Neither removes the need to listen.

objectives.label: Discuss the boundaries of the compact with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Whichever form is chosen, draw its edges in pencil. A map of cooperation should show where people agreed, not where we hope to own them.

choices.title: A federation by local ratification
choices.result: Villages may ratify a shared council with limited powers. Each receives the text, travel support, and a clear withdrawal procedure.

choices.title: A network of specific agreements
choices.result: Villages sign the services they want to share. Coordinators publish the gaps between agreements so no community is silently assumed to be covered.

quests.title: The Thaw Finds Every Weak Join
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXVI | The Work after the Last Page
quests.story:
The spring thaw reveals leaks in the temporary shelters. Mara asks for repairs before the closing ceremony.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The ceremony budget loses a decoration and gains several sound repairs.

objectives.label: Discuss the thaw repairs with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Winter proved the shelters could keep people alive. Spring is asking whether they can remain dry. Passing one test does not mean the work has stopped changing.

objectives.label: Discuss the shelter departures with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Families leave when their next home is ready. The calendar has thawed faster than some roofs.

quests.title: Return What Was Borrowed
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXVI | The Work after the Last Page
quests.story:
Fen inventories borrowed boats, tools, and bedding. Jorge wants the damaged items named before anyone signs a return receipt.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The public account includes the less photogenic work of putting borrowed things right.

objectives.label: Discuss the borrowed equipment with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Check every return with its owner. A tired volunteer should not discover later that helping us cost them their only useful boat.

objectives.label: Discuss the replacement account with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: Repairs and replacements belong in the winter cost. Omitting them makes the next relief plan look cheaper by hiding who paid.

quests.title: Seeds beyond the Pass
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXVI | The Work after the Last Page
quests.story:
Tamsin asks northern growers which seed they actually want. Iona adds the permitted deliveries to a map that now carries local names.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The first spring delivery follows a map made with its recipients.

objectives.label: Discuss the spring seed request with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: We send what the growers requested and keep their planting advice with the stock. A familiar crop here may fail on their hillside.

objectives.label: Discuss the spring delivery map with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The names have been checked by the villages. The protected ridge remains blank. Knowing more has not made every boundary disappear.

quests.title: The Report That Includes Us
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXVI | The Work after the Last Page
quests.story:
Eldara asks every institution involved to record one mistake and its remedy before celebrating the season.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The chronicle records corrections that can be checked after its authors have left the room.

objectives.label: Discuss the watch's own report with Elian
objectives.dialogue: We underestimated waiting time and overpacked the first escort. The remedy is in next winter's schedule, with someone assigned to check it.

objectives.label: Discuss the institutional corrections with Sera
objectives.dialogue: An admission becomes useful when a later reader can find what changed. I have linked each correction to a person responsible for following it up.

quests.title: A Place at an Ordinary Table
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXVI | The Work after the Last Page
quests.story:
The companions gather for a meal without a council agenda. Eldara sends you to invite those most likely to keep working through it.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: The table fills gradually, with a place saved for the person still on duty.

objectives.label: Discuss the ordinary supper with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The tools are put away. Tell Tamsin I mean it this time. If the world needs a hinge during supper, it can wait until the plates are cleared.

objectives.label: Discuss the invitation to rest with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: I will come if someone else takes the late check. Rest is easier to accept when it has been arranged rather than merely recommended.

objectives.label: Discuss the late check with Fen
objectives.dialogue: I have the late check. Save me a plate and let the others eat while the bread is warm.

quests.title: The Next Page Belongs to Someone Else
quests.chapter: Book V | The Winter of Unwritten Names
quests.section: XXXVI | The Work after the Last Page
quests.story:
Eldara prepares to close the fifth book. She asks you to hear the archivist, the traveler, and the steward before deciding what a finished chronicle means.

Complete the objectives in the order shown. Discuss each named topic with the specified NPC, then report to Eldara.
quests.aftermath: BOOK V COMPLETE. Eldara leaves a fresh notebook beside the five finished volumes. The next story may begin in another hand.

objectives.label: Discuss the fifth book with Sera
objectives.dialogue: We have recorded what we know, the accounts that disagree, and the questions still open. That is enough to close a volume without claiming the world is settled.

objectives.label: Discuss the next journey with Iona
objectives.dialogue: There are roads I have not walked. I no longer mark them empty. When I go, I will bring questions and enough supplies to return.

objectives.label: Discuss the work that continues with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The kitchens, hearings, ferries, and repairs will continue tomorrow. A covenant is kept in those ordinary appointments. Thank you for helping us make promises people can find.

quests.title: The Lock on the Common Room
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Rowan | A Key for Every Neighbor
quests.story:
Rowan inherited a public room whose key is held by someone who has moved away. Ask Mara to inspect its lock.

Accept this quest from Rowan, complete its objectives, then return to Rowan with the report.
quests.aftermath: Rowan posts opening hours and names two keyholders.

objectives.label: Discuss the common-room lock with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The lock is sound. Its ownership is the problem. I can repair the fittings, but Rowan needs a key policy before someone else becomes the only person who can open the door.

quests.title: A Room after the Ferry
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Rowan | A Key for Every Neighbor
quests.story:
The room closes before the last ferry arrives. Rowan asks whose journeys its timetable overlooks.

Accept this quest from Rowan, complete its objectives, then return to Rowan with the report.
quests.aftermath: An evening session opens for residents arriving after work.

objectives.label: Discuss the evening visitors with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The late boat carries workers. Keep one evening open and I will put the hours beside the landing schedule.

quests.title: Chairs with a Reason to Stay
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Rowan | A Key for Every Neighbor
quests.story:
Rowan asks Tamsin what makes a meeting room usable for more than its quickest speakers.

Accept this quest from Rowan, complete its objectives, then return to Rowan with the report.
quests.aftermath: The room gains quiet seats and scheduled breaks.

objectives.label: Discuss the meeting-room seats with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Seats near the exit, room to move, and breaks announced in advance. People should not have to disclose a private difficulty to ask for a comfortable place.

quests.title: The Rules on One Page
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Rowan | A Key for Every Neighbor
quests.story:
Rowan asks Sera to shorten the room's inherited regulations.

Accept this quest from Rowan, complete its objectives, then return to Rowan with the report.
quests.aftermath: The notice fits on one page, with a contact for corrections.

objectives.label: Discuss the common-room rules with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Keep the purpose, hours, and way to complain. A rule that needs a clerk to translate it gives the clerk more power than the rule admits.

quests.title: The First Unwelcome Question
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Rowan | A Key for Every Neighbor
quests.story:
A visitor challenges Rowan at an open session. Elian has been asked to attend the next meeting.

Accept this quest from Rowan, complete its objectives, then return to Rowan with the report.
quests.aftermath: Rowan answers the question in the public minutes.

objectives.label: Discuss the difficult meeting with Elian
objectives.dialogue: I will keep the exits safe. I will not remove someone for asking Rowan an uncomfortable question. Tell him the watch expects him to answer it himself.

quests.title: A Fund Nobody Has to Beg For
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Rowan | A Key for Every Neighbor
quests.story:
The room needs a repair fund. Rowan asks Jorge for an account that protects donors' privacy.

Accept this quest from Rowan, complete its objectives, then return to Rowan with the report.
quests.aftermath: A public ledger records each repair and its receipt.

objectives.label: Discuss the common-room account with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: Publish income, spending, and receipts. Gifts can be anonymous without making the spending anonymous too.

quests.title: An Address Everyone Can Find
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Rowan | A Key for Every Neighbor
quests.story:
Iona notices the room appears under three different names. Rowan asks for a usable direction.

Accept this quest from Rowan, complete its objectives, then return to Rowan with the report.
quests.aftermath: The room appears on the map with its opening hours.

objectives.label: Discuss the common-room address with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Use the name on its door and describe the nearest crossing. Keep the older names in the index so a newcomer carrying an old note can still find it.

quests.title: The Spare Key
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Rowan | A Key for Every Neighbor
quests.story:
Rowan wants to leave the room in other hands for an afternoon. Ask Mara whether the repairs can wait.

Accept this quest from Rowan, complete its objectives, then return to Rowan with the report.
quests.aftermath: Rowan gives a second steward the key and leaves before the meeting ends.

objectives.label: Discuss the spare key with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The repairs are finished. The door works without Rowan standing beside it. A useful public room should survive its steward taking a walk.

quests.title: A Book Returned with Notes
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Sera receives a library book full of objections. Ask Rowan whether the library has ever invited corrections.

Accept this quest from Sera, complete its objectives, then return to Sera with the report.
quests.aftermath: Sera starts a folder of reader corrections.

objectives.label: Discuss the annotated library book with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Our rules mention damage six times and questions not once. Copy the objections and ask the reader whether we may circulate them.

quests.title: Ink for an Uncertain Memory
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
A sailor remembers a voyage differently from the official account. Sera sends you to Fen for the working record.

Accept this quest from Sera, complete its objectives, then return to Sera with the report.
quests.aftermath: The library displays the log beside the repair receipts.

objectives.label: Discuss the disputed voyage with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The log records the route we intended. The repair account records where we actually stopped. Keep both before deciding the sailor remembered badly.

quests.title: The Apprentice's Drawing
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
An apprentice illustrates a difficult machine. Sera asks Mara to check it without rewriting the author's voice.

Accept this quest from Sera, complete its objectives, then return to Sera with the report.
quests.aftermath: The apprentice is credited as the author of the guide.

objectives.label: Discuss the apprentice's drawing with Mara
objectives.dialogue: It shows the awkward step my instructions skipped. Correct the measurements and keep the explanation. It is clearer because the apprentice remembers what was difficult.

quests.title: A Shelf beyond the Stair
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Sera wants more readers to reach the reference books. Ask Tamsin what makes the reading room difficult.

Accept this quest from Sera, complete its objectives, then return to Sera with the report.
quests.aftermath: A lending reference shelf opens beside the entrance.

objectives.label: Discuss the reference shelf with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Bring the most-used books down and provide copies that can leave the room. Access is more than being allowed through the front door.

quests.title: The Map with a Private Corner
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Sera prepares a map exhibit. Iona promised not to publish one household's location.

Accept this quest from Sera, complete its objectives, then return to Sera with the report.
quests.aftermath: The exhibit explains why some information is absent.

objectives.label: Discuss the exhibition map with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Use the public copy. The blank corner records a promise made to the people who guided us; it is not an error to fill in.

quests.title: A Correction in Large Letters
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
A leaflet names the wrong watch volunteer. Sera asks Elian to carry the corrected account.

Accept this quest from Sera, complete its objectives, then return to Sera with the report.
quests.aftermath: The corrected leaflet thanks the right volunteer and identifies the error.

objectives.label: Discuss the mistaken credit with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Print the correction where people saw the original. A quiet amendment cannot undo a public mistake if nobody knows to look for it.

quests.title: The Reader Who Disagrees Again
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
The annotated book returns with another objection. Sera asks Jorge how he handles a disputed receipt.

Accept this quest from Sera, complete its objectives, then return to Sera with the report.
quests.aftermath: Sera reopens one note and explains why another remains unchanged.

objectives.label: Discuss the second objection with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: Show the calculation again. Explain an incorrect objection and act on a correct one. Being tired of a question does not settle it.

quests.title: A Catalogue of Questions
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Sera invites Rowan to inspect a catalogue organized by questions instead of royal patrons.

Accept this quest from Sera, complete its objectives, then return to Sera with the report.
quests.aftermath: The catalogue has space for questions no current book answers.

objectives.label: Discuss the new library catalogue with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: I found crop records before the portrait of the king who funded their binding. That is a useful order for a library trying to feed people.

quests.title: The Hammer with Three Owners
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Mara finds a hammer listed as gift, loan, and workshop stock. Ask Jorge to trace its receipts.

Accept this quest from Mara, complete its objectives, then return to Mara with the report.
quests.aftermath: Mara returns the hammer with a repaired handle and an explanation.

objectives.label: Discuss the disputed hammer with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: The sale was canceled after the gift note was copied. I will correct the record and reimburse the lender for the time it was missing.

quests.title: A Loan without a Favor
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Mara proposes a tool library. Rowan must decide whether borrowers need a personal recommendation.

Accept this quest from Mara, complete its objectives, then return to Mara with the report.
quests.aftermath: The tool library opens without requiring introductions.

objectives.label: Discuss the tool-loan rules with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: A recommendation favors people who already know us. Use a simple record and repair process; let newcomers borrow under the same rules.

quests.title: Instructions for a Wet Afternoon
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Fen reports that tool labels dissolve aboard boats. Mara asks him to test a practical lending record.

Accept this quest from Mara, complete its objectives, then return to Mara with the report.
quests.aftermath: The harbor receives a dry tool chest and a spare inventory.

objectives.label: Discuss the harbor tool crate with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Put the list inside the dry lid and mark the tools themselves. A record that survives only on a workshop wall will not survive its first voyage.

quests.title: The Handle That Hurts
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
An apprentice avoids one tool. Tamsin helps Mara investigate without blaming their strength.

Accept this quest from Mara, complete its objectives, then return to Mara with the report.
quests.aftermath: Mara adds several handle sizes to the rack.

objectives.label: Discuss the apprentice's handle with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Ask where it hurts and change the grip. A tool made for one pair of hands is not a fair test of every other pair.

quests.title: When a Borrowed Tool Breaks
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
A borrower hides a cracked chisel, fearing debt. Elian suggests a less intimidating return process.

Accept this quest from Mara, complete its objectives, then return to Mara with the report.
quests.aftermath: The return rules distinguish damage, wear, and deliberate misuse.

objectives.label: Discuss the broken-tool return with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Record what happened before assigning responsibility. If every accident becomes an accusation, the next broken tool stays hidden until it injures someone.

quests.title: The Cost of Teaching Slowly
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Mara wants paid time to train apprentices. Rowan asks how to record work that produces fewer goods.

Accept this quest from Mara, complete its objectives, then return to Mara with the report.
quests.aftermath: The accounts include paid teaching hours.

objectives.label: Discuss the training hours with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: List instruction as work. A workshop cannot teach another generation while pretending every hour must produce a saleable hinge.

quests.title: The Apprentice Signs the Plan
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Sera prepares a workshop history. Mara asks her to credit the apprentice who redesigned tool returns.

Accept this quest from Mara, complete its objectives, then return to Mara with the report.
