quests.aftermath: The apprentice signs the next revision before Mara does.

objectives.label: Discuss the apprentice's credit with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Their name goes beside the design, including corrections made after the trial. Attribution should explain the work, not decorate its cover.

quests.title: A Workshop after Closing
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Mara promises to stop on time. Fen can deliver the last repaired tools.

Accept this quest from Mara, complete its objectives, then return to Mara with the report.
quests.aftermath: Mara closes with unfinished work safely scheduled for tomorrow.

objectives.label: Discuss the last tool delivery with Fen
objectives.dialogue: I have the crate and receipt. Tomorrow morning is acceptable. Nothing in this box requires Mara to miss supper.

quests.title: The Roster with No Blank Space
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Elian's roster leaves nobody free to be sick. Tamsin requests a reserve shift.

Accept this quest from Elian, complete its objectives, then return to Elian with the report.
quests.aftermath: Elian adds cover and rest periods.

objectives.label: Discuss the reserve watch with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: People become ill whether a roster permits it or not. Cover is part of staffing, not a favor granted after someone collapses.

quests.title: The Route behind the Kitchens
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Iona notices the patrol avoids a dark kitchen lane. Elian asks who uses it.

Accept this quest from Elian, complete its objectives, then return to Elian with the report.
quests.aftermath: Patrols follow the people they protect.

objectives.label: Discuss the kitchen-lane patrol with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Workers go home there after the main road quiets. Start with their arrival times instead of drawing a patrol that only looks balanced on paper.

quests.title: A Shield Is Also Weight
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Mara questions identical equipment for different assignments.

Accept this quest from Elian, complete its objectives, then return to Elian with the report.
quests.aftermath: Elian approves equipment by assignment.

objectives.label: Discuss the patrol equipment with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The harbor watch climbs wet ladders; the gate watch mostly stands. Issue loads they can use safely and store replacements where the work happens.

quests.title: The Complaint at the Gate
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
A traveler reports a guard demanding a fee. Elian sends you for the written access rules.

Accept this quest from Elian, complete its objectives, then return to Elian with the report.
quests.aftermath: The watch publishes access rules and opens a complaint record.

objectives.label: Discuss the gate-fee complaint with Spire Guard
objectives.dialogue: There is no personal entry fee in my orders. Record the traveler's account. We can investigate without making them face the guard alone.

quests.title: The Quietest Shift Report
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Caelen helps Elian recognize useful patrols without battles.

Accept this quest from Elian, complete its objectives, then return to Elian with the report.
quests.aftermath: Routine patrols receive credit for prevention.

objectives.label: Discuss the uneventful patrol with Caelen
objectives.dialogue: List routes checked, people helped, and hazards left for the next shift. If only a fight earns recognition, someone will look for one.

quests.title: A Letter without an Order
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Elian writes to a former recruit. Sera offers to read the draft.

Accept this quest from Elian, complete its objectives, then return to Elian with the report.
quests.aftermath: Elian sends no recruitment notice with the letter.

objectives.label: Discuss the former recruit's letter with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Say they owe you no reply. Ask about their life before mentioning the vacancy. They should believe your concern even if they never wear the uniform again.

quests.title: Who Checks the Captain
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Rowan proposes a review of Elian's decisions.

Accept this quest from Elian, complete its objectives, then return to Elian with the report.
quests.aftermath: Elian signs the terms before reading the complaints.

objectives.label: Discuss the captain's review with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The same rules apply to you. People may give evidence without your permission; you may answer without controlling the record.

quests.title: The Alarm Someone Else Answers
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Elian takes a day away. Fen agrees to manage routine messages until the duty officer arrives.

Accept this quest from Elian, complete its objectives, then return to Elian with the report.
quests.aftermath: The watch completes a day under another leader.

objectives.label: Discuss the captain's day away with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The officer has the roster. I will call Elian only for the defined emergencies, not because his name is easier to find than the handover.

quests.title: The Path Drawn through a Garden
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Iona | An Atlas with Return Routes
quests.story:
A proposed shortcut crosses a garden. Iona asks Tamsin where visitors can pass.

Accept this quest from Iona, complete its objectives, then return to Iona with the report.
quests.aftermath: The atlas clearly marks the public path.

objectives.label: Discuss the garden shortcut with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: The outside path stays open. The beds are somebody's work, not blank ground between convenient points. Ask before adding an entrance.

quests.title: A Map for the Last Boat
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Iona | An Atlas with Return Routes
quests.story:
Fen asks Iona to include the late landing.

Accept this quest from Iona, complete its objectives, then return to Iona with the report.
quests.aftermath: The map gains hours and a waiting shelter.

objectives.label: Discuss the last-boat map with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Mark when service ends and where someone can wait safely. A landing without a timetable is half a direction.

quests.title: The Bridge That Cannot Be Promised
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Iona | An Atlas with Return Routes
quests.story:
Mara inspects an unreliable bridge. Iona asks how to mark its changing condition.

Accept this quest from Iona, complete its objectives, then return to Iona with the report.
quests.aftermath: The atlas gains dated condition notes.

objectives.label: Discuss the uncertain bridge with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Mark the inspection date and alternative crossing. Do not print safe in permanent ink over a structure we are still repairing.

quests.title: A Name Borrowed from a Home
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Iona | An Atlas with Return Routes
quests.story:
Sera finds a village labeled for a former landlord. Iona asks for its present name.

Accept this quest from Iona, complete its objectives, then return to Iona with the report.
quests.aftermath: The present name appears on the map.

objectives.label: Discuss the village-name index with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Lead with the residents' name and keep the old one in the index. Readers can find the place without making the landlord its owner on every page.

quests.title: The Road a Patrol Does Not Own
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Iona | An Atlas with Return Routes
quests.story:
Elian offers survey escorts. Iona wants refusal to remain possible.

Accept this quest from Iona, complete its objectives, then return to Iona with the report.
quests.aftermath: Notices separate route information from escort arrangements.

objectives.label: Discuss the optional survey escort with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The escort is an offer. We explain dangers and respect a refusal. Public travel cannot depend on agreeing to be watched by us.

quests.title: The Scale of a Tired Journey
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Iona | An Atlas with Return Routes
quests.story:
Tamsin asks Iona to mark rest stops.

Accept this quest from Iona, complete its objectives, then return to Iona with the report.
quests.aftermath: The atlas adds a page of comfortable stops.

objectives.label: Discuss the resting-place map with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Show shelter, water, and seats. Two journeys of equal length can ask very different things of the traveler.

quests.title: Corrections at the Counter
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Iona | An Atlas with Return Routes
quests.story:
Jorge offers a map-correction box. Iona asks him to retain uncertainty.

Accept this quest from Iona, complete its objectives, then return to Iona with the report.
quests.aftermath: Unverified corrections enter an inspection queue.

objectives.label: Discuss the correction box with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: I will date each report and protect sources when asked. You verify them; the loudest customer does not automatically become our cartographer.

quests.title: The Copy She Keeps
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Iona | An Atlas with Return Routes
quests.story:
Iona sends Rowan the public atlas and keeps her traveling copy.

Accept this quest from Iona, complete its objectives, then return to Iona with the report.
quests.aftermath: Iona packs a blank page and supplies for the return.

objectives.label: Discuss the public atlas with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: The public copy leaves room for changes. Keep your old one. Serving everyone need not mean surrendering every personal note.

quests.title: A Garden without a Rest Day
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden Keeps Its Keeper
quests.story:
Tamsin asks Mara to fix tools that make the garden take every hour.

Accept this quest from Tamsin, complete its objectives, then return to Tamsin with the report.
quests.aftermath: Tamsin advertises for a paid assistant.

objectives.label: Discuss the garden tools with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The handles split and blades are blunt. Repairs save effort, but you also need a second keeper. Better tools cannot replace a day off.

quests.title: What the Soil Remembers
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden Keeps Its Keeper
quests.story:
Iona helps Tamsin investigate a failing bed.

Accept this quest from Tamsin, complete its objectives, then return to Tamsin with the report.
quests.aftermath: The log tracks conditions alongside harvests.

objectives.label: Discuss the failing garden bed with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Record light, water, and previous planting. Leave the cause open until observations support it; a notebook may begin with an unanswered question.

quests.title: The Pantry beyond the Harvest
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden Keeps Its Keeper
quests.story:
Fen offers storage for surplus. Tamsin asks for a rotation plan.

Accept this quest from Tamsin, complete its objectives, then return to Tamsin with the report.
quests.aftermath: The pantry receives labels and an inspection rota.

objectives.label: Discuss the garden pantry with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Date each batch and put oldest usable stock nearest the door. A full pantry conceals waste when nobody knows what arrived first.

quests.title: A Request without an Explanation
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden Keeps Its Keeper
quests.story:
Rowan asks visitors to justify each request. Tamsin proposes a shorter form.

Accept this quest from Tamsin, complete its objectives, then return to Tamsin with the report.
quests.aftermath: The shorter form protects private circumstances.

objectives.label: Discuss the garden aid form with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: We need the request and delivery details, not an account of someone's worst month. I will remove questions we cannot justify using.

quests.title: The Recipe in the Margin
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden Keeps Its Keeper
quests.story:
Sera finds conflicting garden recipes. Tamsin requests careful labeling.

Accept this quest from Tamsin, complete its objectives, then return to Tamsin with the report.
quests.aftermath: The archive separates testimony from garden practice.

objectives.label: Discuss the conflicting garden recipes with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Both remain historical notes marked unverified. An interesting account must be distinguishable from an approved instruction.

quests.title: A Watch for the Quiet Hours
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden Keeps Its Keeper
quests.story:
Elian arranges night checks so Tamsin can leave.

Accept this quest from Tamsin, complete its objectives, then return to Tamsin with the report.
quests.aftermath: A clear handover replaces constant calls.

objectives.label: Discuss the garden night check with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The list explains what to inspect and whom to call. We contact Tamsin for a real problem, not because nobody read the instructions.

quests.title: The Apprentice Has a Question
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden Keeps Its Keeper
quests.story:
Mara's apprentice designs a raised bed. Tamsin asks its user to choose the height.

Accept this quest from Tamsin, complete its objectives, then return to Tamsin with the report.
quests.aftermath: The bed is built after a practical trial.

objectives.label: Discuss the raised-bed plan with Mara
objectives.dialogue: We test a small section with the gardener. A desk measurement should not decide how someone bends for years.

quests.title: One Evening outside the Gate
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Tamsin | The Garden Keeps Its Keeper
quests.story:
Tamsin asks Fen to confirm the handover before taking an evening away.

Accept this quest from Tamsin, complete its objectives, then return to Tamsin with the report.
quests.aftermath: Tamsin leaves the garden in capable hands.

objectives.label: Discuss the garden evening handover with Fen
objectives.dialogue: The stock is counted, delivery covered, and assistant has the key. Go while there is light enough to enjoy the walk.

quests.title: A Berth for an Unfamiliar Boat
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Fen | The Harbor on an Ordinary Day
quests.story:
Fen asks Rowan to stop reserving safe berths for familiar captains.

Accept this quest from Fen, complete its objectives, then return to Fen with the report.
quests.aftermath: The berth board publishes practical rules.

objectives.label: Discuss the newcomer's berth with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Allocate by need, size, and weather. Familiar captains join the same queue. Rules should explain the harbor rather than preserve our friendships.

quests.title: The Ladder below the Waterline
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Fen | The Harbor on an Ordinary Day
quests.story:
Mara inspects a rescue ladder unreachable at low water.

Accept this quest from Fen, complete its objectives, then return to Fen with the report.
quests.aftermath: The repaired ladder is tested from the water.

objectives.label: Discuss the rescue ladder with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Extend it below ordinary low water and test it wet. Appearing in an inventory does not make a ladder a working rescue device.

quests.title: The Harbor Map at Night
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Fen | The Harbor on an Ordinary Day
quests.story:
Iona helps Fen distinguish similar lights.

Accept this quest from Fen, complete its objectives, then return to Fen with the report.
quests.aftermath: The chart shows each landing's pattern.

objectives.label: Discuss the night-harbor marks with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Give each landing a distinct pattern and mark it on the chart. People should not need daylight to identify the light they followed.

quests.title: Supplies for the Passenger Who Waits
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Fen | The Harbor on an Ordinary Day
quests.story:
Tamsin requests food and blankets for canceled sailings.

Accept this quest from Fen, complete its objectives, then return to Fen with the report.
quests.aftermath: The cancellation plan includes meals and updates.

objectives.label: Discuss the canceled-ferry supplies with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Warm the waiting place before announcing the update. Uncertainty should not also mean hunger and cold.

quests.title: The Receipt That Came Back Wet
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Fen | The Harbor on an Ordinary Day
quests.story:
Jorge helps Fen reconstruct a ruined receipt.

Accept this quest from Fen, complete its objectives, then return to Fen with the report.
quests.aftermath: The harbor stores duplicate receipts on shore.

objectives.label: Discuss the damaged receipt with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: Compare copies and stock counts. Wet paper does not prove a customer owes a second payment.

quests.title: A Rescue without an Audience
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Fen | The Harbor on an Ordinary Day
quests.story:
Elian offers volunteers for drills. Fen wants room to make and correct mistakes.

Accept this quest from Fen, complete its objectives, then return to Fen with the report.
quests.aftermath: The second drill is quieter and safer.

objectives.label: Discuss the rescue exercise with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Record what failed and repeat after corrections. Volunteers should leave prepared, not merely glad someone else made the largest mistake.

quests.title: Names beside the Cargo Totals
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Fen | The Harbor on an Ordinary Day
quests.story:
Sera asks Fen for deckhands' stories.

Accept this quest from Fen, complete its objectives, then return to Fen with the report.
quests.aftermath: Crews contribute accounts by choice.

objectives.label: Discuss the deckhands' record with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Invite accounts and allow refusals. Their work belongs in the record; their private lives do not automatically belong to the archive.

quests.title: The Ferry That Leaves without Him
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Fen | The Harbor on an Ordinary Day
quests.story:
Fen lets another captain take the route. Iona checks the chart.

Accept this quest from Fen, complete its objectives, then return to Fen with the report.
quests.aftermath: Fen watches the ferry depart over an unhurried breakfast.

objectives.label: Discuss the independent ferry chart with Iona
objectives.dialogue: The stops and return bearings are here. If the captain finds a gap, we amend the chart instead of deciding that only Fen can sail it.

quests.title: The Fence around an Idea
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Ysolde | A Sanctuary with an Exit
quests.story:
Ysolde proposes a temporary shelter. Iona checks the ground before construction.

Accept this quest from Ysolde, complete its objectives, then return to Ysolde with the report.
quests.aftermath: The sanctuary begins with a revised boundary.

objectives.label: Discuss the sanctuary boundary with Iona
objectives.dialogue: A path crosses the western edge. Move the shelter inward. Protection for one life should not cut another person off from home.

quests.title: Food Is Not a Summons
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Ysolde | A Sanctuary with an Exit
quests.story:
Tamsin asks Ysolde to secure provisions away from visitors.

Accept this quest from Ysolde, complete its objectives, then return to Ysolde with the report.
quests.aftermath: Food storage is separated from the public route.

objectives.label: Discuss the sanctuary food stores with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Store food away from the approach and log its use. Unplanned feeding can teach an animal to seek people whose reactions it cannot predict.

quests.title: The Hunter Reads the Tracks
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Ysolde | A Sanctuary with an Exit
quests.story:
Caelen agrees to inspect without assuming every track requires a hunt.

Accept this quest from Ysolde, complete its objectives, then return to Ysolde with the report.
quests.aftermath: The log distinguishes presence from danger.

objectives.label: Discuss the sanctuary tracks with Caelen
objectives.dialogue: These marks show passage, not an attack. Make room and watch. If a threat appears, describe its behavior before choosing a response.

quests.title: A Gate Opened from Both Sides
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Ysolde | A Sanctuary with an Exit
quests.story:
Mara designs a retreat route for keepers.

Accept this quest from Ysolde, complete its objectives, then return to Ysolde with the report.
quests.aftermath: The gate passes a practical rehearsal.

objectives.label: Discuss the keeper's retreat with Mara
objectives.dialogue: The latch must work from safety under stress. Test with cold hands and an obstructed path, not only in a tidy workshop.

quests.title: The Visitor Who Wanted Proof
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Ysolde | A Sanctuary with an Exit
quests.story:
Elian helps answer visitors seeking a closer look at a resting dragon.

Accept this quest from Ysolde, complete its objectives, then return to Ysolde with the report.
quests.aftermath: Visitors receive a clear rule and its reason.

objectives.label: Discuss the sanctuary visitor rule with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The boundary remains. Curiosity is understandable; permission is still required. We can explain that without turning refusal into a quarrel.

quests.title: A Ledger without a Menagerie
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Ysolde | A Sanctuary with an Exit
quests.story:
Sera asks how to record creatures without claiming ownership.

Accept this quest from Ysolde, complete its objectives, then return to Ysolde with the report.
quests.aftermath: Departures become ordinary entries.

objectives.label: Discuss the sanctuary catalogue with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Record dates, observations, and uncertainty. Leave space for departure. Following a living creature in a book does not make it ours.

quests.title: The Cost of an Empty Enclosure
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Ysolde | A Sanctuary with an Exit
quests.story:
Rowan questions the budget for a sometimes empty shelter.

Accept this quest from Ysolde, complete its objectives, then return to Ysolde with the report.
quests.aftermath: The budget funds readiness.

objectives.label: Discuss the empty sanctuary budget with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Prepared space has value before an emergency fills it. We can inspect costs without asking you to keep an animal captive to justify them.

quests.title: After the Last Guest Leaves
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Ysolde | A Sanctuary with an Exit
quests.story:
Fen offers to move temporary barriers. Ysolde wants the borrowed ground restored.

Accept this quest from Ysolde, complete its objectives, then return to Ysolde with the report.
quests.aftermath: The shelter closes a season by restoring the ground.

objectives.label: Discuss the sanctuary return cargo with Fen
objectives.dialogue: I will store the reusable sections. Inspect the ground with its users afterward; an empty enclosure can still leave a damaged path.

quests.title: The Contract Names a Road
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Caelen asks Elian to define a threatened route before agreeing to a vague hunt.

Accept this quest from Caelen, complete its objectives, then return to Caelen with the report.
quests.aftermath: Caelen specifies the route and reporting duty.

objectives.label: Discuss the road-hunt contract with Elian
objectives.dialogue: The eastern approach is threatened after dark. Clear it, date the report, and brief the next watch. A kill count alone cannot tell travelers the road is safe.

quests.title: Tracks across the Same Ground
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Iona helps distinguish a creature's route from separate sightings.

Accept this quest from Caelen, complete its objectives, then return to Caelen with the report.
quests.aftermath: The board groups related observations.

objectives.label: Discuss the repeated sightings with Iona
objectives.dialogue: Several sightings may be one moving animal. Mark dates and direction before estimating a population from frightened reports.

quests.title: A Hunt Stopped at the Boundary
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Ysolde requests a nesting area remain outside the contract.

Accept this quest from Caelen, complete its objectives, then return to Caelen with the report.
quests.aftermath: Caelen marks an exclusion around the nests.

objectives.label: Discuss the nesting-ground boundary with Ysolde
objectives.dialogue: Observe from the edge and leave the approach open. The reported threat was elsewhere. An uneventful search does not need a substitute target.

quests.title: Armor after the Assignment
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Mara requests equipment checks between commissions.

Accept this quest from Caelen, complete its objectives, then return to Caelen with the report.
quests.aftermath: Caelen adds a check between contracts.

objectives.label: Discuss the hunters' repairs with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Check straps and joints as well as dents. Something can look intact and fail at the first important movement. Repair it before departure.

quests.title: The Person Who Waited at Home
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Tamsin asks for honest news about a delayed hunter.

Accept this quest from Caelen, complete its objectives, then return to Caelen with the report.
quests.aftermath: The office records contacts and update arrangements.

objectives.label: Discuss the delayed hunter with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Give the last confirmed location, who is checking it, and the next update time. Promise a report, not an outcome beyond your control.

quests.title: Paid for Coming Back Safely
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.story:
Jorge helps Caelen pay for useful work when a threat moves on.

Accept this quest from Caelen, complete its objectives, then return to Caelen with the report.
quests.aftermath: Caelen posts a contract for careful work and a useful report.

objectives.label: Discuss the revised hunt payment with Jorge
objectives.dialogue: Pay for the agreed survey and evidence. Requiring a corpse regardless of conditions buys pressure to find a victim.

quests.title: The Receipt under the Counter
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Jorge | The Price of a Promise
quests.story:
Jorge finds an unpaid refund. Ask Sera to record its correction.

Accept this quest from Jorge, complete its objectives, then return to Jorge with the report.
quests.aftermath: Jorge sets the refund aside with a clear record.

objectives.label: Discuss the old refund with Sera
objectives.dialogue: Keep the original and dated correction. An account should show how it was repaired so the mistake is easier to recognize next time.

quests.title: A Fair Price for a Repair
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Jorge | The Price of a Promise
quests.story:
Mara asks Jorge to account for more than replacement iron.

Accept this quest from Jorge, complete its objectives, then return to Jorge with the report.
quests.aftermath: Quotes separate materials and labor.

objectives.label: Discuss the repair price with Mara
objectives.dialogue: Count inspection, fitting, and testing. Hiding labor makes a price look kind while asking the craftsperson to donate the missing hours.

quests.title: The Delivery That Must Wait
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Jorge | The Price of a Promise
quests.story:
Fen refuses an unsafe departure. Jorge must explain the delay.

Accept this quest from Jorge, complete its objectives, then return to Jorge with the report.
quests.aftermath: The notice offers a refund or a dated update.

objectives.label: Discuss the delayed shop delivery with Fen
objectives.dialogue: Publish the reason, next update, and option to cancel. I sail when the route is safe enough, not when an angry notice makes waiting uncomfortable.

quests.title: Credit without a Public Story
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Jorge | The Price of a Promise
quests.story:
Rowan requests small emergency advances with private applications.

Accept this quest from Jorge, complete its objectives, then return to Jorge with the report.
quests.aftermath: The fund opens under short, published terms.

objectives.label: Discuss the emergency-credit record with Rowan
objectives.dialogue: Publish rules and the fund balance. Keep applications private and provide a way to challenge refusal. Inspect decisions without exposing applicants.

quests.title: The Apprentice Checks the Till
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Jorge | The Price of a Promise
quests.story:
Tamsin reports an apprentice skipping breaks to balance every coin.

Accept this quest from Jorge, complete its objectives, then return to Jorge with the report.
quests.aftermath: Jorge adds a shared closing check and paid break.

objectives.label: Discuss the apprentice's closing shift with Tamsin
objectives.dialogue: Give the handover a time limit and second checker. A discrepancy can wait for rested eyes; exhaustion is not an accounting method.

quests.title: A Shop That Keeps Its Word
quests.chapter: Companion Chronicles | The Work Between Journeys
quests.section: Jorge | The Price of a Promise
quests.story:
Elian reviews disputed sales at Jorge's request.

Accept this quest from Jorge, complete its objectives, then return to Jorge with the report.
quests.aftermath: Jorge posts refund and complaint terms beside the prices.

objectives.label: Discuss the disputed shop sale with Elian
objectives.dialogue: Hear both accounts, inspect receipts, and explain the decision. Leave a route for review. Calling someone dishonest should not be the first tool used.

quests.title: 01 | A Key in the Archive
quests.story:
Sera holds the Old Eye in trust for the expedition.

Bring 16 paper for the restored archive. Then choose Discuss a quest with Sera and turn in this assignment through Covenant quests to receive one Old Eye. You do not need to find or hold the eye first. Earlier tracked kills and crafts count; donated materials are consumed at turn-in.

This is one of the twelve trials required before Eldara sends you to the Spire portal.

Next: speak to Iona after main quest 08.
quests.aftermath: The first key belongs to someone willing to preserve a history other than their own. Next: speak to Iona after main quest 08.

objectives.label: Bring 16 paper for the restored archive
Discuss the Old Eye with Sera
objectives.dialogue: The first key belongs to someone willing to preserve a history other than their own.

quests.title: 02 | The Scout Returns
quests.story:
Iona holds the Rogue Eye in trust for the expedition.

Craft a compass. Then choose Discuss a quest with Iona and turn in this assignment through Covenant quests to receive one Rogue Eye. You do not need to find or hold the eye first. Earlier tracked kills and crafts count; donated materials are consumed at turn-in.

This is one of the twelve trials required before Eldara sends you to the Spire portal.

Next: speak to Tamsin after main quest 10.
quests.aftermath: A scout earns trust by finding the way home. Keep the compass; this eye is your reward. Next: speak to Tamsin after main quest 10.

objectives.label: Discuss the Rogue Eye with Iona
objectives.dialogue: A scout earns trust by finding the way home. Keep the compass; this eye is your reward.

quests.title: 03 | Warmth before Winter
quests.story:
Tamsin holds the Cold Eye in trust for the expedition.
